title: Head - Learning and Development
description:
Designation: Assistant Vice President


Location: India Maharashtra BSLAMC , One India Bulls Cente


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Key Result Areas (****Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions** **(****Max 1325 Characters)**  

Learning Strategy \& Governance  

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of the Learning \& Development strategy aligned to business priorities.
* Conduct structured Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across Sales, Service, and enabling functions.
* Design and periodically refresh the organization\-wide learning architecture using the 70:20:10 framework.
* Present monthly, quarterly, and annual learning plan reviews and impact analysis to leadership.
* Partner with HR COEs (Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, Talent Management) to ensure alignment of learning initiatives with capability building and career pathways
  

Sales Capability \& Functional Learning  

* Design and implement structured learning journeys for Sales and Service teams, covering product knowledge, domain depth, consultative selling, objection handling, and mindset shift.
* Build dedicated capability frameworks for emerging channels such as DHNI and Alternate Sales in partnership with functional heads.
* Calendarize and deliver role\-based learning programs that support productivity improvement and cross\-product selling.
* Leverage internal Subject Matter Experts and external partners to co\-create and deliver specialized modules.
  

Building Managerial Development  

* Create success in Front line managers by ensuring coverage through various learning interventions identified for this cohort and measuring their learning effectiveness.
* Address capability gaps identified through TNA and mid\-year business feedback.
* Facilitate group\-wide programs through TTT certifications and collaborate with ecosystem learning teams to improve overall Learning Index and training coverage
  

Induction \& Cross\-LOB Enablement  

* Drive structured induction programs for all new hires, including frontline salesforce.
* Ensure full learning coverage and accelerated ramp\-up of new joinees.
* Deliver multi\-product capability programs across AMC and broader ABC ecosystem.
* Identify early performance or capability gaps and escalate appropriately to Zonal Heads/HRBPs.
  

Productivity Reinforcement \& Learning Impact  

* Monitor on\-the\-job implementation of training through structured follow\-ups.
* Partner with Zonal and Regional leaders to identify low productivity cohorts and design targeted reinforcement interventions.
* Analyze periodic performance data in collaboration with Business and HR teams to measure learning effectiveness and refine interventions.

title: Talent Acquisition Analyst
description:
Overview:

As a Professional Recruiter focused on professional hiring, you will play a key role in attracting, assessing, and hiring top talent for PepsiCo. You will collaborate with hiring managers, HR business partners, and stakeholders to develop and execute strategic hiring plans while ensuring a seamless and engaging candidate experience.


This role requires a blend of strategic talent sourcing, stakeholder management, employer branding, data\-driven decision\-making, and process excellence to support our talent acquisition goals.

  


Responsibilities:

Recruitment Consulting, Advisory \& Partnership

* Partner with hiring managers to conduct recruitment strategy meetings, analyze hiring needs, define job requirements, and craft customized recruitment plans.
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights on talent availability, salary benchmarks, and industry hiring trends.
* Act as a trusted talent advisor, guiding hiring managers on interviewing best practices, inclusive hiring strategies, candidate experience standards, and the effective use of assessment tools.
* Align recruitment efforts with workforce planning, strategic TA initiatives, and business priorities.
* Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with hiring managers, HR, and other key stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates and proactive communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle, ensuring alignment and transparency.


Candidate Sourcing, Attraction, and Engagement

* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies to identify and attract both active and passive talent using job boards, social media, employee referrals, and networking.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles to reduce time\-to\-find and time\-to\-accept.
* Leverage PepsiCo’s employer branding and recruitment marketing to enhance talent attraction, including writing compelling job descriptions, optimizing job postings, and engaging candidates through our established EVP messaging.
* Deliver a consistent, high\-touch candidate experience, ensuring timely communication and engagement at every stage of the hiring process.


End\-to\-End Recruitment Process Management \& Execution

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from job requisition creation to offer acceptance, ensuring efficiency, quality, and a seamless and positive candidate experience while adhering to all established process standards.
* Conduct structured interviews and behavioral assessments applying the company's established interviewing framework and standards to evaluate candidate qualifications, skills, and culture add.
* Facilitate hiring manager debrief sessions and provide structured feedback to support data\-driven hiring decisions.
* Manage the offer process, including extending offers and negotiating compensation packages in partnership with HR, Total Rewards, and Hiring Manager.


Data\-Driven Recruitment, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement

* Track and analyze key recruitment metrics (e.g., time\-to\-find, time\-to\-accept, candidate experience scores) to continuously improve hiring outcomes.
* Utilize external labor market data and talent analytics to refine sourcing strategies and hiring decisions.
* Ensure adherence to global hiring policies, DEI standards, and local employment laws.
* Stay updated on industry best practices, recruitment technology advancements, and innovative hiring trends.
* Effectively utilize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and other recruitment technologies to manage the recruitment process.


Process Adherence and Data Management

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and CRM platforms.
* Follow established recruitment process standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and data integrity.


Global Talent Acquisition Initiatives Contribution and Team Support

* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) in process, technology, or data, actively participating in SME networks and providing support to the assigned team.
* Team Support and Development: Provide backup support for team leaders and act as a coach/buddy for new hires to facilitate onboarding and development.
* Global Project Participation: Contribute as a Talent Acquisition Delivery SME on assigned global projects.


Specialized Responsibilities Based on Recruiter Type

* Focus on hiring for corporate/professional roles in Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, R\&D, and other business functions.
* Source specialized talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional associations, networking events, and industry\-specific job boards.
* Manage longer\-cycle, strategic hiring with structured interview processes and leadership engagement.
* Provide data\-driven insights and talent intelligence to support workforce planning.
* Work closely with senior leaders and HRBPs to align hiring strategies with business goals.

The ServiceNow Architect serves as the primary technical authority for the platform and works in close partnership with enterprise architecture, IT operations, business process owners, and product teams to transform ServiceNow from an ITSM tool into a strategic enterprise workflow automation hub. This individual operates at the intersection of technical depth and business strategy, shaping how work gets done across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Platform Architecture \& Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Own the ServiceNow platform architecture, including instance strategy (production, sub\-production), domain separation considerations, upgrade planning, and long\-term roadmap
* Establish and enforce platform governance standards: development practices, scoped application design, naming conventions, update set management, and code review processes
* Define the ServiceNow data model strategy, including CMDB architecture, CI relationships, and data integrity governance in alignment with ITIL and business requirements
* Lead architecture reviews for all significant ServiceNow development efforts, providing design authority sign\-off and ensuring alignment with platform best practices
* Maintain architectural documentation including reference architectures, design decision records, and platform topology diagrams

**Enterprise Integration Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and own the integration architecture connecting ServiceNow to the broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including ERP, ITSM, HR systems, monitoring platforms, identity providers, and cloud services
* Architect integrations using ServiceNow's native capabilities — IntegrationHub, Flow Designer spokes, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Event Management — as well as third\-party iPaaS platforms where applicable
* Define integration patterns and standards for inbound/outbound data exchange, ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability at enterprise scale
* Lead integration efforts with key enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint), Azure, Active Directory/Entra ID, monitoring and observability tools, and HR platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors)
* Establish and govern the ServiceNow CMDB as the authoritative source of truth for enterprise configuration data, including discovery tooling, reconciliation rules, and CSDM alignment
* Partner with security and IAM teams to architect identity federation, SSO (SAML/OIDC), and role\-based access control across the platform

**Workflow Automation**
-----------------------

* Lead the architectural strategy for enterprise workflow automation on the ServiceNow platform, spanning IT, HR, Legal, Finance, Facilities, and other business domains.
* Design scalable, reusable automation frameworks using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, and Scripted REST APIs.
* Architect end\-to\-end process automation for key workflows including incident management, change management, employee onboarding/offboarding, procurement, and request fulfillment.
* Define standards for automation governance: approval workflows, SLA frameworks, notification architecture, and audit trail design.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the enterprise by partnering with process owners and analyzing ticket and workflow data.
* Champion low\-code/no\-code automation patterns to enable business teams to build within governed guardrails, reducing reliance on centralized IT development

**ServiceNow AI \& Intelligence Capabilities:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Drive the adoption and architectural strategy for ServiceNow's AI and intelligence portfolio, including:


	+ **Now Assist (Generative AI):** Virtual agent augmentation, case summarization, resolution note generation, and AI\-assisted search across ITSM and non\-ITSM workflows.
	+ **Predictive Intelligence:** ML\-based classification, categorization, and routing of incidents, cases, and requests.
	+ **AI Search:** Unified enterprise search architecture leveraging ServiceNow's semantic search capabilities.
	+ **Process Optimization:** Identifying bottleneck and deviation patterns in workflows using ServiceNow's process mining capabilities.
	+ **Virtual Agent:** Conversational interface design and NLU topic architecture integrated with enterprise channels (Microsoft Teams, web portal).
* Assess organizational AI readiness, including data quality, CMDB health, and historical record hygiene as prerequisites for effective AI model performance
* Define governance and ethical use standards for AI\-driven automation and decision support within ServiceNow
* Stay current with ServiceNow's AI roadmap and evaluate new capabilities for applicability within the enterprise context

**Product \& Module Ownership**
-------------------------------

* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow product lines as adopted by the organization, which may include:


	+ IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM)
	+ HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Legal Service Delivery, Workplace Service Delivery
	+ Security Operations (SecOps), GRC / Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
	+ Customer Service Management (CSM), App Engine / Creator Workflows
* Evaluate new ServiceNow modules for strategic fit, total cost of ownership, and integration complexity before platform adoption decisions are made
* Manage the platform upgrade lifecycle, including scoped impact analysis, regression testing strategy, and stakeholder communication

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on ServiceNow capabilities, investment priorities, and platform roadmap
* Partner with process owners and product managers to translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions
* Mentor ServiceNow developers, administrators, and business analysts — establishing technical standards and elevating team capability
* Represent ServiceNow architecture in enterprise architecture governance forums and technology review boards
* Manage the relationship with ServiceNow account teams, technical success managers, and implementation partners to maximize platform value

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in a senior architecture or technical lead role focused on ServiceNow
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across core ServiceNow platform capabilities:


	+ **Platform:** Instance architecture, Application Engine, Scoped Apps, CMDB, CSDM, Update Sets, ATF
	+ **Automation:** Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, Scheduled Jobs, Event Management
	+ **Integration:** REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, LDAP/SSO, Azure/AWS connectors, iPaaS patterns
	+ **ITSM/ITOM/ITAM:** Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Discovery, Service Mapping, HAM/SAM
	+ **Portal \& UX:** Service Portal, Now Experience (UI Builder), Employee Center
* Demonstrated experience architecting ServiceNow integrations with complex, heterogeneous enterprise technology environments
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting: JavaScript (Glide API), REST API design, and client/server\-side scripting
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL processes and their implementation within ServiceNow
* Experience leading platform upgrades across major ServiceNow releases in production environments
* Excellent documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, integration maps, and design specifications

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

**Platform Mastery:** Expert command of ServiceNow architecture patterns, APIs, and the platform's evolving capability landscape

**Integration Thinking:** Designs loosely coupled, resilient integration architectures that scale across enterprise system boundaries

**Process Orientation:** Translates ambiguous business processes into structured, automatable workflows with appropriate governance

**AI Fluency:** Understands where AI and machine learning add genuine value and architects for responsible, effective adoption

**Strategic Influence:** Earns credibility with senior stakeholders and shapes platform investment decisions

**Mentorship:** Actively develops others and raises the overall technical capability of the ServiceNow practice

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow's AI portfolio, including Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, and AI Search
* ServiceNow certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Certified System Administrator (CSA)
	+ Certified Application Developer (CAD)
	+ Certified Implementation Specialist — ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, SecOps, or equivalent
	+ Now Certified Expert (NCE) designation
* Experience with ServiceNow App Engine and building custom scoped applications for enterprise use cases
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and their application to platform governance
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with Microsoft 365, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace, Splunk, Workday, or SAP
* Background in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government) and associated compliance requirements
* Exposure to DevOps practices as applied to ServiceNow development (source control integration, CI/CD pipelines, ATF)

Department

Human Resources

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle from manpower requisition to candidate onboarding.

* Sales \& Business Development
* CRM \& Customer Service
* Marketing \& Digital Marketing
* Projects \& Construction
* Engineering \& Architecture
* Procurement \& Contracts
* Finance \& Accounts
* Administration \& Facility Management

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously

* Proactive and result\-oriented approach
* Good stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work under defined timelines and hiring targets

Experience

**3–6 years of experience in recruitment**, preferably in:

* Infrastructure
* Architecture/Engineering
* High\-volume Sales Recruitment

Experience in using job portals, LinkedIn and other digital sourcing platforms is essential.

* Number of positions closed within the defined timeline
* Time taken to close open positions
* Quality of shortlisted candidates
* Interview\-to\-selection ratio
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio
* Candidate database development

The ideal candidate should be **highly proactive, organised and persistent in follow\-up**, with the ability to independently drive recruitment assignments and ensure timely closure of critical positions.

**PUD Manager**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

Regional PUD Manager

**Pickup \& Delivery Unit (PUD) / Cluster of PUDs**

  

  

**Travel Required**

  

**25%** **50%** **þ** **75%**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The PUD Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end operations of one or more Pickup \& Delivery Units (PUDs), ensuring safe, timely and cost\-effective execution of first\-mile pickup, last\-mile delivery and customer service operations. The role is accountable for operational performance, fleet readiness, workforce productivity, customer satisfaction and service quality across the assigned locations.


Reporting to the Regional PUD Manager, the incumbent leads frontline operational teams, coordinates with cross\-functional stakeholders and transport partners, and ensures seamless integration of pickup, delivery and hub operations. The role drives operational discipline, revenue assurance, people capability and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with organisational standards and customer commitments.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To lead and manage the operations of assigned Pickup \& Delivery Units by delivering operational excellence, customer service, workforce productivity, fleet optimisation and revenue assurance while ensuring safe, compliant and profitable first\-mile and last\-mile operations aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**PUD Operations Leadership**

* Lead the overall operations of the assigned PUD(s), ensuring consistent achievement of operational, service and business objectives.
* Drive operational planning and execution across pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
* Ensure adherence to operational workflows, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and service commitments.
* Monitor daily operational performance and implement timely corrective actions to address service gaps.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, fleet and infrastructure to support business requirements.

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Manage first\-mile pickup and last\-mile delivery operations to achieve committed service levels and customer expectations.
* Monitor daily pickup schedules, delivery performance and route execution to maximise operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely processing, dispatch and movement of shipments through seamless coordination with hubs and service centres.
* Drive reduction in missed pickups, delivery exceptions, return\-to\-origin (RTO) cases and operational delays.
* Monitor shipment visibility and ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.

**Customer Service \& Service Quality**

* Drive customer service excellence by ensuring adherence to pickup and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Customer Service teams to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and service issues.
* Monitor customer feedback, operational performance and Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends to improve customer experience.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational issues impacting customers.
* Support implementation of initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, service reliability and operational quality.

**Fleet, Route \& Resource Management**

* Ensure optimum deployment and utilisation of fleet resources to support daily pickup and delivery operations.
* Coordinate with Fleet Operations teams and transport partners to ensure vehicle availability and route optimisation.
* Monitor route productivity, vehicle utilisation and operational efficiency across assigned PUDs.
* Ensure availability of operational equipment, handheld devices and infrastructure to support uninterrupted operations.
* Support contingency planning during peak volumes, network disruptions and operational exigencies.

**Revenue Assurance \& Operational Controls**

* Drive revenue protection through adherence to shipment acceptance standards, reweigh compliance and operational controls.
* Ensure accurate processing of shipment documentation, manifests, COD reconciliation and operational records.
* Monitor operational exceptions impacting revenue and implement timely corrective actions.

title: Associate PO Management
description:
Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.3 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.  

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.  

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.


Responsibility:  

* Work on all SF cases about PO issues from E\-Billing / Collections Team
* Setup PO rules in WINWEB as per customer/sales team information
* Assist the Billing team on PO issues about any SOs (Sales orders) that are created which have a PO issue from a system standpoint (WIN)
* Provide PO resolution by Liaising with multiple stakeholders External/Internal stakeholders (Account Manager, Branch Manager, CEMs, Buyers, and requestors via calls \& e\-mails (Ex: PO Underfunded, Invalid PO, Wrong PO, No PO, PO Closed, PO Not Available, PO lines not matching with invoice line items)
* Review the workbench (WIN System) and work on SOs created with Bad POs and resolve the same
* Review the existing controls available in the system and recommendations for changes or enhancements for better adherence to PO guidelines
* Review the PO funds for both Blanket orders and job\-specific orders and timely inform the concerned members to add funds for seamless billing
* Prepare necessary documentation on the PO rules and guidelines and educate the teams on their adherence and compliance.
  

 Pre\-requisites:  

* Individuals should have good client handling skills with PO knowledge (Downstream \& Upstream)
* Independently work on all complex PO issues by contacting the customer/sales department for PO resolution.
* Individuals should be analytical in understanding the PO issue by doing RCA (Root cause analysis) to provide the resolution
* Hands\-on knowledge of the Billing / E\-Billing process is an added advantage
* Should have interacted with Buyers/requestors (Customers) / sales team (Internal)
* Good e\-mail writing skills
* Should be flexible to work and extend their support for any additional hours as per business requirements.

title: Human Resources & Administration Operations Manager
description:
*India*

This role will be based in India – Bangalore and reports to the Human Resources Director, APAC.


**Brief Summary**
-----------------


This position will manage day\-to\-day human resources operations and general administration. The role is responsible for recruitment coordination, employee lifecycle management, attendance and payroll inputs, statutory compliance, employee engagement, performance management support, facilities administration, vendor coordination, and maintenance of HR records.


The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of HR processes and Indian labour laws, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to independently manage multiple operational priorities.


**Job Description**
-------------------


**Human Resources Operations**


* Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmation, transfer, promotion, and separation.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, experience certificates, and other employment\-related documents.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HR databases, and HRIS information.
* Monitor attendance, leave, shift schedules, overtime, and employee regularisation requests.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, and final settlements.
* Respond to employee queries regarding HR policies, attendance, leave, payroll, benefits, and employment matters.
* Ensure HR processes are completed within established timelines and approval procedures.

**Recruitment and Onboarding**


* Coordinate manpower requisitions with department heads and hiring managers.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment consultants, referrals, social media, and other appropriate channels.
* Screen applications, schedule interviews, coordinate selection processes, and follow up with candidates.
* Conduct reference and background verification as required.
* Manage pre\-joining documentation and joining formalities.
* Plan and conduct employee induction and orientation programmes.
* Track recruitment status, joining ratios, offer acceptance, and vacancy closure timelines.

**Performance Management and Training**


* Coordinate performance appraisal cycles and ensure timely completion of employee assessments.
* Support managers in setting performance goals and documenting employee feedback.
* Maintain records of appraisals, promotions, increments, and performance improvement plans.
* Identify training requirements in consultation with department heads.
* Coordinate internal and external training programmes.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance records, feedback, and effectiveness reports.

**Employee Engagement and Relations**


* Support employee engagement, recognition, welfare, and retention initiatives.
* Organise employee events, celebrations, meetings, surveys, and team\-building activities.
* Address employee concerns professionally and escalate sensitive matters when necessary.
* Support grievance handling and disciplinary processes in accordance with company policies.
* Conduct exit interviews, analyse reasons for attrition, and recommend corrective measures.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and professional work environment.

**HR Policies and Statutory Compliance**


* Assist in communicating and implementing HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate documentation relating to Provident Fund, ESIC, professional tax, gratuity, bonus, maternity benefits, and other applicable employee benefits.
* Maintain statutory registers, licences, notices, returns, and compliance records.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors, government authorities, and legal advisers when required.
* Support internal, statutory, and HR audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and sensitive organisational records.

**Administration and Facilities Management**


* Manage day\-to\-day office administration and ensure smooth workplace operations.
* Coordinate housekeeping, security, transportation, canteen, maintenance, stationery, and other administrative services.
* Manage office infrastructure, repairs, preventive maintenance, and utility services.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, hotel bookings, local transportation, and related documentation.
* Maintain records of company assets, access cards, mobile phones, laptops, SIM cards, and other administrative resources.
* Monitor office safety, security, hygiene, and emergency preparedness.
* Coordinate renewals of insurance policies, annual maintenance contracts, registrations, licences, and service agreements.
* Support office relocation, expansion, renovation, and workplace improvement projects when required.

**Vendor and Cost Management for HR and Administration Tasks**


* Identify, evaluate, appoint, and coordinate with HR and administration vendors.
* Obtain quotations, prepare comparative statements, and support commercial negotiations.
* Monitor vendor performance, service quality, contractual obligations, and payment documentation.
* Verify invoices and coordinate with the Finance department for timely payment.
* Track administrative expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Maintain vendor contracts, purchase records, and renewal schedules.

**Management Information and Reporting**


* Prepare periodic HR and administration reports for management review.
* Track manpower, recruitment, attendance, leave, overtime, attrition, training, and employee engagement data.
* Maintain HR dashboards and provide accurate information for management decision\-making.
* Monitor departmental budgets and report actual expenditure against approved budgets.
* Ensure all HR and administration data is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline.
* MBA, postgraduate degree, or diploma in Human Resource Management is preferred.
* Certification in labour laws, payroll, compliance, or HR analytics will be an advantage.
* 10–12 years of relevant experience in HR operations and general administration.

**Required Skills \& Abilities**
--------------------------------


* Practical knowledge of recruitment, payroll inputs, compliance, employee relations, performance management, and office administration.
* Experience working in \[Manufacturing/IT/Services/Corporate Office/Relevant Industry] is preferred.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Ability to work in a team environment.
* Experience handling vendors, audits, statutory documentation, and administrative budgets is desirable.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Time management skills.
* Professional and approachable behaviour.

For interested candidates, you may send your CV and contact details to rashmi@edmundoptics.in

For our business, for clients, and for you

**APEX FUND SERVICES**

**Functional Title:** Senior Process Associate

**Department:** BPM

**Employment Type:** Permanent

**About Apex**


Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices. The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single\-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.


We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. You are prepared to work hard, love what they do and be prepared to innovate.


Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more that we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.

**About the Team:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Senior Process Associate to join our dynamic BPM – Lease Abstraction team. The Senior Process Associate is responsible for executing, reviewing, and improving operational processes with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency. This role supports complex tasks, ensures adherence to quality standards, and acts as a point of contact for escalations. The Senior Process Associate also contributes to process improvements, provides guidance to junior team members, and ensures timely delivery of assigned responsibilities.


Apex India office is in Pune or Hyderabad and Apex Bulgaria office is in Sofia, but we offer smart working, with some time working from home, as required.

**Key duties and responsibilities**

* Lease Document Review \- Analyze commercial and residential lease agreements to identify and extract critical financial, legal, and operational terms.
* Data Abstraction \& Validation: Review and validate key information such as rent schedules, renewal options, termination clauses, and operating expenses with 100% accuracy.
* Quality Assurance Leadership: Conduct juniors reviews, audits, and provide feedback to ensure compliance with SOPs and quality standards.
* Time Management: Ensure timely completion of deliverables within defined SLAs and KPIs.
* Mentorship \& Training: Support training and onboarding of new team members by sharing best practices and process knowledge
* Client\-Specific Customization \- Adapt abstraction formats and processes to meet unique client requirements and project specifications.
* Collaboration and Communication \- Work closely with team members, project leads, and cross\-functional departments to resolve queries and ensure smooth workflow.
* Documentation and Reporting \- Maintain proper documentation of abstracted leases and generate reports as required for internal tracking or client delivery.
* Compliance and Confidentiality \- Ensure all lease data is handled in accordance with confidentiality agreements and regulatory standards.
* Continuous Improvement \- Contribute to process enhancements, automation initiatives, and best practices to improve efficiency and accuracy

**Experience and skills:**

* Education: Any Graduate, preferably B.Com
* 3–5 years of experience in lease abstraction, real estate administration, or legal documentation review.
* Proven track record of working with commercial and residential lease agreements across diverse geographies and property types.
* Experience using lease abstraction platforms, document management systems, or real estate databases (e.g., Yardi, MRI, Lucernex, Visual Lease, CoStar).
* Familiarity with BPM (Business Process Management) environments and client\-driven service delivery models.
* Attention to Detail: Ability to identify and extract nuanced lease terms with precision and consistency.
* Legal and Real Estate Acumen: Understanding of lease structures, terminology, and implications of clauses such as CAM, rent escalations, and renewal options.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to interpret complex documents and assess their impact on financial and operational metrics.
* Strong understanding of process workflows, SOPs, and quality control methodologies.
* Technical Proficiency: Skilled in Microsoft Excel, Word, and lease abstraction tools; comfortable navigating digital document workflows.
* Communication: Clear and concise written communication to produce accurate lease summaries and collaborate with internal teams.
* Time Management: Capable of handling multiple leases and meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality.
* Quality Assurance: Commitment to maintaining high standards through peer reviews, audits, and continuous improvement.

**Nice to have:**

* Exposure to global lease portfolios and multi\-jurisdictional legal frameworks.
* Knowledge of IFRS 16 / ASC 842 lease accounting standards.
* Experience in process automation or working with AI\-assisted abstraction tools.

Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

Job Description

* For non\-complex and complex submissions, independently fulfill the following responsibilities:

Prepare briefing packages for regulatory agency meetings or scientific advice and contribute to or support the agency interactions.

* Excellent interpersonal / communication skills including excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent customer service skills, with the ability to work both as a team member and independently.
* Good quality management skills.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Office Applications.
* Ability to interact with staff from multiple departments and offices to establish project standards.
* Good initiative, adaptability, and pro\-activity.
* Strong analytical skills, good attention to detail.

title: SME-Learning & Development
description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid role as a subject matter expert in learning and development focuses on creating and delivering training solutions for claims adjudication and health care compliance within provider and payer environments. The position supports night shift operations enabling global coverage while ensuring accurate claims handling regulatory alignment and continuous capability building across multiple functional teams.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design comprehensive training programs that build strong capability in claims adjudication processes for provider and payer operations while aligning with current business objectives and quality standards.
  
Develop detailed learning content that simplifies complex health care claim rules and workflows so that new and existing team members can perform adjudication tasks with high accuracy and consistency.
  
Deliver engaging virtual and classroom training sessions during night shift hours to support hybrid team members and ensure consistent knowledge transfer across locations.
  
Conduct targeted training needs analysis by collaborating with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps in claims adjudication and prioritize high impact learning interventions.
  
Monitor learner performance data and quality audit outcomes to refine course materials and ensure that training directly improves claim resolution accuracy and turnaround time.
  
Ensure that all learning content reflects current health care regulations and privacy requirements related to HIPAA so that team members handle sensitive information responsibly.
  
Create practical simulations and case based exercises that mirror real life provider and payer claim scenarios to help learners build confidence and decision making skills.
  
Provide ongoing floor support during production hours by answering process queries and clarifying adjudication rules so that associates can resolve complex claims efficiently.
  
Collaborate with process experts and compliance teams to update training materials whenever there are changes in benefit designs coding standards or regulatory guidance.
  
Track training effectiveness through feedback surveys assessments and quality metrics and present insights that show how learning programs support business performance and member satisfaction.
  
Maintain detailed training records and documentation that support internal audits and demonstrate adherence to organizational learning standards and regulatory expectations.
  
Coordinate with workforce management and team supervisors to schedule training sessions that minimize business disruption while meeting the needs of night shift hybrid associates.
  
Support the adoption of digital learning tools and knowledge repositories so that team members can access updated claims adjudication and HIPAA guidance on demand.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Apply strong knowledge of health care claims adjudication rules benefit structures and payment policies to design technically accurate learning content for provider and payer processes.
  
Use hands on experience with provider and payer workflows to explain real world scenarios and guide learners in applying policy rules to complex claim situations.
  
Apply working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and data privacy expectations to embed compliance guidelines into every stage of the learning and support process.
  
Utilize prior operations or quality experience within claims environments to connect training topics with performance outcomes such as first pass resolution and reduced rework.
  
Demonstrate proficiency with common office productivity tools and learning platforms to create clear presentations job aids and reference guides for hybrid teams.
  
Communicate clearly and inclusively with diverse audiences across global locations while adapting explanations to suit different experience levels and learning styles.
  
Show readiness to work permanent night shifts in a hybrid work model while maintaining high levels of responsiveness reliability and collaboration with onshore and offshore partners.

title: HR & Executive Assistant | Zenara Health
description:
About Zenara


Zenara is building technology to enable a new way to practise psychiatry: whole\-person, continuous and psychiatrist\-led care.


Our products help psychiatric practices understand patients more deeply before visits, capture more useful signal between visits, and support more consistent ongoing care — while keeping the psychiatrist firmly at the centre of clinical decision\-making.


We are a growing, distributed company with team members working across India and other international markets. We are expanding the team, and we need a highly organised and trusted person to strengthen our recruitment, people\-operations and executive\-administration capabilities.


About the role
You will support our founders and leadership team across four connected areas: recruitment coordination, HR and people administration, timesheet and payroll administration, and confidential executive support.


This is a hands\-on, execution\-focused role. You will keep processes moving, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly with candidates and colleagues, and make sure agreed tasks are completed reliably and on time.


To be clear about the level: this is not a senior HR strategy or employment\-law role. We are looking for someone practical, highly organised, discreet, and capable of independently running routine people and administrative workflows without being chased.


You will have access to sensitive information — employee records, compensation details, candidate information, company plans and leadership discussions. Trust, discretion and sound judgement are essential parts of the job, not add\-ons to it.


What you will own1\. Recruitment coordination* Maintain the recruitment pipeline across multiple open positions
* Keep Workable, Linear and other recruitment trackers accurate and up to date
* Review incoming applications against agreed role requirements
* Organise and prioritise candidates for review
* Coordinate first\-round screening and interviews
* Communicate with candidates throughout the process
* Schedule interviews across India, US and other relevant time zones
* Send interview instructions, reminders and follow\-ups
* Track candidate completion of screening, interviews and assessments
* Coordinate background and reference checks where required
* Prepare candidate information for interviewers
* Maintain accurate records of interview outcomes and next steps
* Make sure candidates are followed up promptly and professionally
* Support offer, pre\-boarding and onboarding administration
* Help improve our recruitment workflows and systems as we scale


We are building technology\-supported recruitment workflows, including automated candidate screening, interview processes, ranking and follow\-up. You will help operate, monitor and improve those workflows rather than relying only on manual administration.


2\. HR and people administration* Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding
* Coordinate collection of required employee information and documents
* Track leave, attendance and other routine people\-administration matters
* Maintain records of probation periods, review dates and employment milestones
* Prepare standard HR letters, documents and internal records
* Support the administration of employment agreements
* Make sure routine HR processes are completed consistently and on time
* Respond to straightforward employee administration questions
* Escalate sensitive or complex employee matters to the founders
* Keep HR files organised, accurate and accessible


This role provides HR administration and coordination. You will not be expected to provide independent legal, employment\-law or senior employee\-relations advice.


3\. Timesheets and payroll administration* Collect and monitor employee timesheets
* Follow up on missing or incomplete submissions
* Maintain accurate records for payroll processing
* Prepare payroll inputs for review and submission
* Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants and other relevant parties
* Track payroll\-related questions and issues
* Maintain records of approved payments and payroll documentation


You will not own payroll, compensation or employment\-policy decisions. Your responsibility is to make sure the administrative process is accurate, organised and completed on time.


4\. Executive assistance* Provide trusted administrative support to our two co\-founders
* Manage and coordinate calendars and meetings
* Schedule internal and external meetings
* Prepare agendas, action lists and follow\-up trackers
* Record or organise meeting actions where required
* Follow up with team members on agreed actions
* Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics
* Organise documents and information for leadership discussions
* Assist with practical administrative tasks and research
* Support occasional projects that need careful coordination and follow\-through


This will include practical, get\-it\-done administrative work. You should be comfortable handling a broad range of tasks without losing sight of priorities.


5\. Confidentiality and information management* Treat employee, candidate, compensation and company information as strictly confidential
* Store and share sensitive information only through approved systems
* Use sound judgement about who should have access to what
* Maintain professional boundaries with colleagues
* Avoid informal discussion of confidential matters
* Escalate any suspected confidentiality or data\-security issue immediately


You will be part of the trusted leadership\-support function. You should be comfortable working openly and warmly with the wider team while understanding that some information simply must not be shared.


Your first 60 days* Understand our current recruitment and HR workflows
* Review and organise existing employee and candidate records
* Get familiar with Workable, Linear and our other systems
* Take ownership of recruitment coordination for the roles we have open
* Establish a reliable process for interview scheduling and candidate follow\-up
* Take over timesheet and payroll administration
* Document recurring HR and executive\-administration processes
* Establish a regular reporting rhythm with the founders
* Identify administrative gaps, duplication or unnecessary manual work


What success looks like* Recruitment pipelines stay accurate and current
* Candidates receive timely, professional communication
* Interviews are scheduled efficiently and follow\-ups are never missed
* Recruitment workflows are consistently operated and steadily improved
* Employee records and HR documents are complete and organised
* Timesheet and payroll administration is accurate and on time
* Routine HR questions and administrative requests are handled without escalation
* The founders spend materially less time on scheduling, follow\-up and administrative coordination
* Sensitive information is handled with complete discretion
* The company has a more reliable and scalable people\-operations process


RequirementsRequired* Previous experience in HR administration, recruitment coordination, executive assistance, office administration or people operations
* Experience coordinating several tasks, candidates or workflows at the same time
* Strong organisational skills and genuine attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal English
* Confidence communicating with candidates, employees, consultants and senior leaders
* Experience maintaining accurate records, trackers and documentation
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office or equivalent
* Ability to work independently in a remote, distributed environment
* Strong follow\-through, and the willingness to chase outstanding actions
* Mature judgement when handling confidential information
* Ability to prioritise and meet deadlines
* Comfort learning new software, automation tools and AI\-enabled workflows
* A calm, professional and dependable working style


Strongly preferred* Experience recruiting for a startup or growing technology company
* Experience supporting recruitment across multiple roles at once
* Experience using Workable, Linear, an applicant\-tracking system or equivalent
* Experience with timesheet and payroll administration
* Previous experience as an executive assistant to founders or senior leaders


Nice to have* Experience supporting international or distributed teams
* Experience coordinating across India, US and UK time zones
* Experience working with confidential compensation or employee information
* Familiarity with AI tools and workflow automation
* Experience documenting and improving administrative processes


Who you are* Trustworthy and discreet
* Highly organised
* Reliable and responsive
* Comfortable taking ownership of routine tasks
* Willing to ask when something is unclear
* Able to work with limited supervision
* Calm under pressure
* Professional with candidates and employees
* Comfortable in a fast\-moving company
* Practical and solutions\-oriented
* Accountable for completion, not just activity


Working hours and location
This is a fully remote role, based anywhere in India.


You will work primarily during Indian working hours, with planned and reasonable overlap with the founders when required. This role should not require a routine late\-night schedule. Any out\-of\-hours work will be occasional, agreed in advance, and proportionate to the business need.


You will work remotely but in regular contact with the founders. Expect regular leadership check\-ins, clear written updates on recruitment and HR workflows, accurate records in the relevant systems, prompt escalation of blockers, visible tracking of outstanding actions, and reliable availability during agreed hours.


Compensation
₹8,00,000 – ₹13,00,000 per year, as a total package. Where you land in that range depends on your experience and demonstrated ability, particularly in executive support and recruitment coordination.

title: Benefits Expert - Invoicing & PO Management
description:
### **Summary**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

  

Location: Hyderabad, India  

  

About The Role:  

As a Benefits Expert \- Invoicing \& PO Management, you independently lead and manage invoicing, purchase order, vendor management, reconciliation, reporting, and governance activities across assigned benefits programs. You do this by partnering closely with the core Benefits team, ensuring operational excellence, maintaining compliance and financial accuracy, and delivering a high\-quality stakeholder experience.  

  

In this role, you serve as a key point of contact for billing and payment\-related processes, supporting business continuity, resolving stakeholder queries, and ensuring the timely and accurate execution of invoicing and PO activities. You also drive continuous improvement initiatives, strengthening controls, enhancing process efficiency, and supporting the evolving needs of the Benefits organization.
### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end\-to\-end Purchase Order (PO) and Invoice Management activities across benefits programs globally, ensuring timely creation, maintenance, amendment, closure, monitoring, processing, approval, payment tracking, and compliance with procurement, finance, and internal control requirements.
* Serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders, vendors, Finance, Procurement, P2P Operations, and business partners to resolve operational issues, invoice discrepancies, payment\-related queries, and support vendor onboarding, master data maintenance, documentation follow\-ups, and vendor lifecycle management.
* Support financial governance activities including budget tracking, accrual reviews, spend monitoring, open commitment management, reconciliations, reporting, and ensuring appropriate cost center usage, financial allocations, and adherence to corporate financial policies and controls.
* Maintain accurate operational databases, trackers, and financial records to ensure transparency, audit readiness, effective decision\-making, and the availability of complete and accurate documentation for audit, compliance, and management reporting activities.
* Monitor operational risks, identify process gaps, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution through collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Support process improvement initiatives focused on enhancing efficiency, strengthening controls, improving stakeholder experience, reducing manual effort, and leveraging automation and digital solutions where appropriate.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, governance materials, and knowledge repositories while supporting business continuity through cross\-training, knowledge sharing, and acting as backup for critical operational processes.
* Take ownership of assigned workstreams, manage multiple priorities, ensure high levels of quality, accuracy, and service delivery, and build strong relationships with global stakeholders through effective communication of operational and financial matters.

**Essential Requirements:**

* Full time graduation with 5\-7 years of experience in Finance Operations, with strong expertise in Accounts Payable, Purchase Order Management, Invoice Processing, and Financial Governance.
* Knowledge of SAP Ariba and procurement processes.
* Proven experience in Contract and Vendor Management, including vendor onboarding, master data maintenance, and stakeholder coordination. MBA or equivalent in Finance is preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial controls, reconciliations, budget tracking, accrual management, and audit/compliance requirements.
* Experience working with global stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, P2P, HR/Benefits, and external vendors in a multinational environment
* Demonstrated track record of driving process improvement, automation, standardization, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Proven experience managing complex operational processes and global stakeholder relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail and ownership of deliverables.

**Desirable Requirements:**

* Familiarity with vendor governance and vendor management activities.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional and geographically diverse stakeholder groups.
* Exposure to process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Experience working in global, complex, and matrixed organizations.

title: Senior Research Associate
description:
Job Description — Research Associate / Process Engineer – Molten Salt Electrolysis

**Company:** Motorall / AmpCycle  
**Position:** Research Associate / Process Engineer – Molten Salt Electrolysis  
**Department:** R\&D / Advanced Materials \& Electrochemical Processing  
**Location:** Rohini, Delhi 110089\.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 2–5 years relevant experience  
**Qualification:** M.Sc./M.Tech./B.Tech. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrochemistry, Metallurgy or a related field

About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on researcher/engineer to work on the development of **molten\-salt electrolysis and high\-temperature electrochemical processes** for the recovery and purification of valuable metallic constituents from complex solid feedstocks.

The candidate will work across the complete laboratory process chain, from **feedstock preparation and pretreatment to electrochemical separation, product recovery, purification and characterization**, with a focus on developing a scalable and commercially viable process.

Key Responsibilities1\. Feedstock Preparation

* Develop methods for receiving, sorting and preparing complex metallic feedstocks.
* Study dismantling, demagnetization and mechanical size reduction requirements.
* Develop crushing, grinding, sieving and particle\-size\-control procedures.
* Evaluate the effect of particle size and feedstock composition on downstream processing.
* Develop suitable methods for removing coatings, surface contaminants, adhesives and other unwanted materials.
* Establish safe handling and storage procedures for processed powders.

2\. Pretreatment \& Conditioning

* Develop thermal, chemical or mechanical pretreatment methods as required.
* Investigate oxidation/reduction behaviour of feedstock materials.
* Optimize removal of unwanted phases and contaminants before electrochemical processing.
* Study moisture, oxygen and impurity control requirements.
* Develop suitable drying and conditioning procedures.
* Establish reproducible feedstock specifications for electrolysis.

3\. Powder Processing

* Develop laboratory\-scale powder\-processing procedures.
* Study particle morphology, size distribution and chemical composition.
* Optimize powder preparation for uniform interaction with molten salts.
* Investigate material losses during crushing, sieving, transfer and handling.
* Maintain material balance throughout the process.

4\. Molten\-Salt Preparation

* Research and select suitable molten\-salt systems for electrochemical processing.
* Prepare and condition molten\-salt electrolytes.
* Study salt composition, melting behaviour and operating temperature.
* Control moisture and contamination in molten\-salt systems.
* Investigate salt conductivity and electrochemical stability.
* Optimize salt\-to\-feedstock ratio and operating conditions.
* Develop procedures for salt recovery, regeneration and reuse where applicable.

5\. Electrochemical Cell Development

* Assist in the design and development of laboratory\-scale molten\-salt electrolysis cells.
* Select suitable electrode, crucible and reactor materials.
* Study electrode configuration and electrode spacing.
* Develop systems for controlled feeding of solid material.
* Establish electrical connections and current/voltage control.
* Evaluate cell design, sealing, insulation and thermal management.
* Develop safe procedures for high\-temperature electrochemical operation.

6\. Molten\-Salt Electrolysis

* Conduct controlled electrolysis experiments under defined temperature and electrical conditions.
* Optimize current density, cell voltage, temperature and electrolysis duration.
* Study electrodeposition behaviour and product formation.
* Investigate selective deposition and separation behaviour.
* Monitor electrochemical parameters during operation.
* Identify factors affecting current efficiency, recovery, purity and energy consumption.
* Troubleshoot unstable electrolysis, electrode degradation, short circuits and other process issues.

7\. Product Collection \& Separation

* Develop methods for collecting deposited metallic products.
* Separate deposited material from electrodes and reactor components.
* Develop washing, salt\-removal and drying procedures.
* Recover entrained molten salt where possible.
* Develop methods for separating different product fractions.
* Minimize product loss during post\-electrolysis processing.

8\. Purification \& Downstream Processing

* Develop suitable post\-processing and purification procedures.
* Study thermal, chemical and electrochemical purification methods where required.
* Optimize removal of residual salts and impurities.
* Develop methods for achieving consistent product purity.
* Establish suitable product specifications based on application requirements.

9\. Characterization \& Analysis

The candidate should be capable of performing or coordinating characterization using techniques such as:

* XRD
* SEM/FESEM
* EDS/EDX
* ICP\-OES / ICP\-MS
* XRF
* Raman spectroscopy
* TGA/DSC
* Particle\-size analysis
* Electrochemical characterization
* Chemical composition analysis
* Metallographic analysis

The candidate will be responsible for correlating feedstock composition, electrolysis parameters and final product quality.

10\. Process Optimization

* Perform experimental optimization of temperature, current density, voltage, salt composition, feedstock loading and electrolysis time.
* Conduct controlled experimental studies and maintain detailed laboratory records.
* Develop material and energy balances.
* Evaluate recovery, purity, current efficiency and specific energy consumption.
* Identify process bottlenecks.
* Develop repeatable laboratory protocols.
* Compare alternative process configurations.
* Support development of Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate.

11\. Scale\-Up

* Support transition from laboratory\-scale experiments to larger electrochemical systems.
* Develop preliminary reactor and cell\-sizing calculations.
* Study heat management and thermal uniformity.
* Evaluate electrode life and reactor material compatibility.
* Develop continuous or semi\-continuous processing concepts where applicable.
* Identify engineering challenges associated with scale\-up.
* Support pilot\-scale equipment development and commissioning.

12\. Process Safety

* Follow strict procedures for high\-temperature operations.
* Develop SOPs for molten\-salt handling.
* Maintain appropriate ventilation and containment systems.
* Follow procedures for handling reactive chemicals, metallic powders and high\-temperature materials.
* Assess risks associated with corrosive salts and chemical exposure.
* Follow appropriate protocols for electrical and high\-current equipment.
* Where applicable, understand and follow institutional procedures for handling **radioactive materials or contaminated materials**.
* Maintain chemical waste and process\-residue management procedures.

13\. Documentation \& R\&D

* Maintain detailed laboratory notebooks and experimental records.
* Prepare technical reports and experimental summaries.
* Develop SOPs and process\-flow documentation.
* Perform literature and patent reviews.
* Benchmark published electrochemical processes.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and IP generation.
* Prepare technical data for pilot projects, grants and commercialization activities.

Required Technical Knowledge

Candidates should have working knowledge of several of the following:

* Molten\-salt electrochemistry
* Electrolysis
* Electrodeposition
* High\-temperature chemical processing
* Electrochemical cell design
* Inorganic chemistry
* Metallurgy
* Materials processing
* Powder processing
* Thermal processing
* Chemical separation
* Electrochemical characterization
* Process development
* Laboratory\-scale reactor development

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates with hands\-on experience in:

* Molten\-salt electrolysis
* High\-temperature electrochemistry
* Electrowinning/electrorefining
* Metal extraction
* Metal deposition
* Chloride/fluoride molten\-salt systems
* Electrochemical separation
* High\-temperature reactors
* Powder metallurgy
* Metallurgical processing
* Recycling of complex metallic feedstocks
* Electrochemical process scale\-up
* High\-current DC power systems
* Inert\-atmosphere processing

Experience with **Glove Box, tube furnace, high\-temperature reactor, potentiostat/galvanostat, DC power supply or electrolysis cell development** will be advantageous.

Educational Qualification

**Preferred:**

* M.Tech./M.E. in Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Electrochemistry or related fields.
* M.Sc. in Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Materials Chemistry or Electrochemistry.
* B.Tech./B.E. in Chemical, Metallurgical, Materials or related engineering disciplines with strong electrochemical research experience.

Experience

**2–5 years of relevant research or industrial experience.**

Freshers are generally not preferred.

Candidates should demonstrate practical laboratory/research experience rather than only theoretical knowledge.

The ideal candidate should be:

* Hands\-on and experimentally strong.
* Comfortable working at high temperatures.
* Strong in electrochemistry and inorganic chemistry.
* Comfortable designing experiments independently.
* Good at troubleshooting experimental failures.
* Strong in scientific data interpretation.
* Comfortable working with laboratory equipment.
* Interested in converting laboratory chemistry into an industrial process.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment where processes are still being developed.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

**Company Description**

Agaram Technologies is a leading provider of Enterprise\-Class Laboratory Informatics and Automation Solutions, offering products such as Laboratory Information Management Systems (Qualis LIMS), Electronic Lab Notebooks (Logilab ELN), and Scientific Data Management Systems (Logilab SDMS). Serving both regulated and non\-regulated labs, Agaramtech caters to industries such as pharmaceuticals, life sciences, petroleum, chemicals, food, and clinical research. With over 25 years of consistent growth, Agaram has built a global presence through a technically skilled team and partnerships in regions like the USA, Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia.
