title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 0 to 5 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

0 to 5 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
Candidates with 0–1 year of experience should demonstrate capability through academic projects, internships, certifications, GitHub repositories, hackathons, prototypes, or hands\-on GenAI experiments.
  
Candidates with 2–5 years of experience should have hands\-on experience building, integrating, testing, or deploying GenAI, AI assistant, chatbot, RAG, automation, or agentic workflow solutions.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.
  
  

**Equivalent qualifications may also be considered:**  

BCA / MCA / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related disciplines from a recognized institution or university.

title: Jr. Research Analyst
description:
Jr. Research AnalystJob Overview

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Jr. Research Analyst** with strong skills in **technical writing, research paper preparation, manuscript revision, and technical content development**.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to understand complex technical concepts, analyze research data, prepare high\-quality research manuscripts, respond to reviewer comments, and continuously learn emerging technologies. The role requires flexibility to work across different technical domains, including engineering, computer science, technology, and related fields.

Key Responsibilities

* Write original research papers based on research objectives, data findings, and technical requirements.
* Prepare clear, precise, and scientifically sound manuscripts suitable for **journals, conferences, and technical publications**.
* Review, revise, and update research manuscripts based on reviewer comments and feedback.
* Ensure manuscripts meet required standards for **technical accuracy, clarity, scientific rigor, and presentation**.
* Conduct technical research and stay updated with the latest technologies, methodologies, tools, and research developments.
* Update research papers, reports, and technical content with recent findings and technological advancements.
* Adapt research and technical writing styles to different domains, including **Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, and other technical fields**.
* Analyze technical data and convert research findings into well\-structured and understandable written content.
* Ensure proper citation, referencing, and bibliography formatting according to required styles such as **IEEE, APA, MLA, and other journal\-specific formats**.
* Search, organize, and verify relevant research references and scholarly sources.
* Create and edit **graphs, charts, diagrams, tables, and technical illustrations** to effectively present research findings.
* Ensure figures, tables, captions, and references are properly aligned with the manuscript content.
* Carefully proofread research documents to identify technical, grammatical, formatting, and consistency\-related issues.
* Collaborate with researchers, technical teams, and peers to understand project requirements and incorporate feedback.
* Maintain a high level of concentration and attention to detail while handling research and documentation tasks.
* Continuously learn new technologies, software tools, research methodologies, and technical domains.

Key RequirementsEducation

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field**.

Experience

* Experience in **technical writing, research paper preparation, manuscript editing, or academic/technical documentation** is preferred.
* Freshers with strong technical writing and research skills may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Strong **technical writing and editing** skills.
* Good understanding of **research methodology and technical documentation**.
* Ability to understand and analyze complex technical information.
* Ability to convert technical data and findings into structured research content.
* Knowledge of **academic research papers, journals, conferences, and publication standards**.
* Familiarity with **IEEE, APA, MLA, or other citation and referencing styles**.
* Experience with reference management and research tools is an added advantage.
* Ability to create and edit **graphs, charts, tables, diagrams, and technical figures**.
* Excellent proofreading and manuscript revision skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work on multiple technical domains and adapt to new subjects quickly.
* Strong learning ability and willingness to learn emerging technologies.
* Good communication, teamwork, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with research databases and scholarly resources.
* Knowledge of tools such as **MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, reference management software, and basic data visualization tools**.
* Basic knowledge of research\-oriented software, AI tools, or technical documentation tools.
* Understanding of journal and conference publication processes.
* Ability to interpret technical diagrams, research results, tables, and statistical data.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for candidates who are:

* **Highly focused and detail\-oriented**
* **Quick learners**
* **Technically curious**

* **Capable of handling detailed technical work for extended periods**
* **Committed to maintaining accuracy and quality in every assignment**

title: Project Engineer (Civil)
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1\.Site Execution \& Supervision**

* Maintain approved drawings, RFIs, inspection reports, material approvals, and site records.
* Maintain photographic records of concealed and completed works.
* Coordinate snagging and closure before handover.
* Support preparation of as\-built drawings and O\&M documentation.
* Ensure final areas are cleaned, protected, tested, and handed over to the user/operations team.
* Execute interior works as per approved architectural, interior, MEP, and shop drawings.
* Supervise civil finishing, partitions, ceilings, flooring, painting, joinery, furniture, glazing, doors, hardware, and other fit\-out activities.
* Ensure correct dimensions, levels, alignment, finishes, and workmanship.
* Plan daily and weekly site activities to achieve project milestones.
* Monitor contractor manpower, materials, tools, and equipment deployment.
* **2\.Drawing \& Technical Coordination**
* Review IFC/GFC drawings, BOQ, specifications, and approved material details before execution.
* Identify drawing discrepancies and raise RFIs/technical clarifications.
* Coordinate interior drawings with electrical, HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, ELV, and other services.
* Verify shop drawings, mock\-ups, samples, and site measurements before production or installation.
* Ensure latest approved drawing revisions are followed at site.
* Proficient in **AutoCAD 2D** for interior and architectural drawings.
* Prepare and modify **floor plans, furniture layouts, reflected ceiling plans, flooring layouts, wall elevations, sections, and detail drawings**.
* Prepare site\-based drawing corrections and revisions based on actual measurements.
* Develop and update **shop drawings** for partitions, ceilings, joinery, furniture, flooring, glazing, doors, and other interior works.
* Coordinate architectural/interior drawings with **electrical, HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, and ELV layouts**.
* Identify clashes and dimensional discrepancies through drawing review before site execution.
* Prepare detailed drawings for critical junctions, finishes, and installation requirements.
* Maintain proper **layers, dimensions, annotations, blocks, scales, plotting standards, and drawing templates**.
* Prepare and maintain **as\-built drawings** reflecting actual site execution.
* Incorporate consultant/client comments and maintain proper drawing revision control.
* Extract quantities and dimensions from AutoCAD drawings to support **BOQ verification and material estimation**.
* Convert site sketches and measurements into accurate CAD drawings.
* Ensure only the **latest approved drawing revision** is issued and used at site.
* Capable of reading and interpreting consultant drawings, technical details, and MEP coordination drawings.
* **Planning \& Progress Monitoring**
* Prepare short\-term execution plans and look\-ahead schedules.
* Track actual progress against the approved project schedule.
* Identify delays, constraints, and dependencies and initiate corrective actions.
* Maintain daily progress reports and weekly progress updates.
* Coordinate material delivery schedules with project requirements.
* **Quality Control**
* Ensure execution complies with approved drawings, specifications, samples, and quality standards.
* Conduct stage\-wise inspections before allowing subsequent activities.
* Prepare and close inspection requests, snag lists, NCRs, and punch points.
* Ensure finished surfaces are protected from damage during subsequent works.
* Conduct final quality checks before handing over completed areas.
* **Contractor \& Vendor Management**
* Coordinate carpentry, false ceiling, flooring, painting, glazing, furniture, signage, and specialist contractors.
* Conduct daily coordination with contractors regarding productivity and priorities.
* Monitor contractor performance against agreed scope, quality, and timelines.
* Verify quantities and work completion for contractor bills.
* Ensure rework due to contractor errors is minimized and rectified promptly.
* **Material Management**
* Verify materials received at site against approved makes, specifications, and quantities.
* Inspect material quality before acceptance and installation.
* Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.
* Forecast material requirements to prevent execution delays.
* Coordinate storage and protection of sensitive finishing materials.
* **Commercial \& BOQ Support**
* Understand BOQ scope and ensure work is executed within contractual requirements.
* Verify site measurements and quantities for billing.
* Identify extra items, deviations, and scope changes before execution.
* Maintain records supporting variation and additional\-work claims.
* Support project cost\-control initiatives and avoid unnecessary rework.
* **MEP \& Interface Coordination**
* Coordinate ceiling layouts with lighting, AC diffusers, sprinklers, detectors, speakers, CCTV, and access panels.
* Coordinate wall finishes and furniture with electrical/data points.
* Ensure MEP concealed works are inspected before closing ceilings, walls, or flooring.
* Resolve clashes between architecture/interiors and services before execution.
* **Safety \& Site Discipline**
* Ensure contractors comply with project EHS requirements.
* Verify use of PPE, safe working platforms, scaffolding, electrical tools, and housekeeping practices.
* Ensure permits are followed for hot work, height work, electrical work, etc.
* Stop unsafe work and escalate serious violations.
* **Documentation \& Handover**

description:
**XSIAM Administrator \& Automation Engineer**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for an XSIAM Administrator \& Automation Engineer to own the day\-to\-day administration, data onboarding, detection engineering and automation strategy of our Cortex XSIAM (Extended Security Intelligence and Automation Management) platform. This role sits at the intersection of security operations engineering and AI\-driven automation — you will design, build, and continuously improve the detection content, playbooks, and AI\-assisted workflows that let our SOC operate at machine speed. You will work closely with multiple security operations team such as incident response, threat hunt, insider risk to ensure XSIAM is correctly configured, fully onboarded, and increasingly autonomous in how it triages, investigates, and responds to threats.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Administration**
* Administer and maintain the Cortex XSIAM tenant: user roles, RBAC, licensing, health monitoring, and platform upgrades.
* Onboard and normalize new data sources (logs, endpoint telemetry, cloud, identity, network) using XDM (Cortex Data Model) mapping and parsing rules.
* Manage integrations and content packs, including third\-party connectors, brokers, and collectors.
* Tune detection content — BIOCs, correlation rules, analytics, and incident scoring — to reduce noise and improve fidelity.
* Monitor platform performance, data ingestion costs, and storage tiering, and troubleshoot ingestion or parsing failures.


**Logging and Detection Engineering**
* Onboard logs directly from sources or via secure data pipeline management solution such as Cribl
* Extend detection engineering scope by creating corelation, analytics rule using XSIAM jupyter notebooks.
* Support detection engineering and threat\-hunting initiatives with automation and XQL query development.


**Automation \& Playbook Engineering**
* Design, build, and maintain automation playbooks (XSOAR/XSIAM playbook engine) to automate alert triage, enrichment, containment, and remediation.
* Develop custom automations, scripts, and integrations (Python) to extend out\-of\-the\-box XSIAM capabilities.
* Continuously identify manual SOC workflows and convert them into automated, auditable playbooks, driving down mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR).
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for playbook and content versioning, testing, and deployment across environments.


**AI\-Driven Security Operations**
* Apply Cortex XSIAM's native AI/ML capabilities (AI\-driven incident scoring, causality analysis, alert clustering, and DRP/attack\-surface insights) to accelerate investigation and reduce analyst workload.
* Integrate large language model (LLM)\-based assistants and agentic workflows into playbooks for tasks such as alert summarization, natural\-language incident querying, phishing/malware triage, and auto\-generated investigation reports.
* Evaluate and pilot emerging AI/agentic\-SOC features (e.g., autonomous investigation agents, AI copilots, natural\-language\-to\-XQL query generation) and lead responsible adoption across the security operations team.
* Build feedback loops and guardrails (human\-in\-the\-loop approval steps, confidence thresholds, audit logging) to ensure AI\-assisted actions remain safe, explainable, and compliant.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools to accelerate development of custom scripts, integrations, and XQL queries, while maintaining rigorous testing and code\-review standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in security operations, SIEM/SOAR administration, or detection/automation engineering.
* Hands\-on experience administering Cortex XSIAM, Cortex XSOAR, or a comparable SIEM/SOAR platform (Splunk SOAR, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, etc.).
* Strong scripting ability in Python, and comfort working with REST APIs to build custom integrations.
* Practical knowledge of XQL (or equivalent query language) for building correlation rules, dashboards, and threat\-hunting queries.
* Solid understanding of SOC workflows: alert triage, incident response, threat intelligence, and case management.
* Experience with data onboarding/parsing (log normalization, XDM/CIM\-style schemas) from diverse sources (EDR, cloud, network, identity).
* Familiarity with applying or integrating AI/LLM capabilities into operational workflows (prompt design, AI copilots, or agentic automation) — production experience preferred, strong conceptual understanding acceptable.


**﻿Preferred Qualifications**
* Palo Alto Networks Certified XSIAM Engineer, XSIAM Analyst, or XSOAR Engineer certification.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions) for security content and playbook lifecycle management.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments.
* Experience with MITRE ATT\&CK\-mapped detection engineering.
* Prior experience deploying agentic AI workflows, AI\-assisted SOC copilots, or natural\-language query interfaces in a security context.


**Education**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, CEH) are preferred.

title: International B2B Marketing Executive (Commission Based)
description:
International B2B Marketing Executive (Commission Based)

About the Company

TradeInfra Networks LLP, based in Telangana, India, is a B2B International Trade Facilitation Service Provider connecting International Buyers with Indian Suppliers. The Company supports businesses throughout the international trade lifecycle, including business connections, verification, negotiations, digital tri\-partite agreements, export services, shipment coordination, after\-sales support and related business services.

The Company primarily serves 10 product sectors from India across 25 international countries.

Role

As an International B2B Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for developing and executing practical digital and organic marketing activities to strengthen TradeInfra's online presence, brand visibility and engagement among relevant Indian and international business audiences.

The role focuses on Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, SEO, Content Marketing, B2B Brand Marketing and organic online growth, using available free tools, platforms and AI technologies.

Important: This role is suitable for candidates who can independently work with free tools and platforms. The Company will not provide paid marketing tools or subscriptions at this stage. The Executive will be expected to build and develop marketing activities from a startup\-level foundation. A B2B website is already available for TradeInfra.

Responsibilities

\- Plan and execute Digital Marketing activities to improve TradeInfra's online visibility and brand presence.

\- Generate relevant B2B leads through digital marketing and organic online channels.

\- Manage Social Media Marketing across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

\- Create, publish and optimise professional B2B content for International Buyers, Indian Suppliers, industries, products and international trade.

\- Execute practical SEO activities, including keyword research, search\-intent research, content optimisation and basic on\-page SEO.

\- Support Website Marketing through useful content, SEO improvements and organic search opportunities.

\- Create AI\-assisted marketing videos, short\-form videos and other visual content using available free AI and digital tools.

\- Use free AI technologies and digital tools for content creation, research assistance, SEO, creative development and marketing productivity.

\- Monitor marketing performance, analyse results and continuously improve campaigns and content.

\- Support the Sales/Business Development team with relevant marketing content, campaigns and audience insights.

\- Maintain accurate marketing records and submit required weekly performance reports to management.

\- Follow Company policies, SOPs, confidentiality requirements and approved brand guidelines.

Compensation

This is a performance\-based opportunity with no fixed salary or guaranteed monthly income.

The Marketing Executive will be eligible for a Performance Incentive of up to 8% on every successful sale generated by the Company, irrespective of which authorised Business Development Executive completes the sale.

The applicable incentive will be based on the Executive's work, performance and demonstrated marketing results.

Incentive eligibility will begin after completion of the first month from the date of joining, subject to satisfactory performance and the Company's applicable incentive policy.

Working Arrangement

1\. Monday to Saturday

2\. Full\-Time Contractual Opportunity

3\. Contract Duration: 3 to 6 Months

4\. Work From Home

5\. Not a Part\-Time Opportunity

6\. Consistent daily marketing activity and timely communication are required.

7\. The Executive must remain actively engaged and reasonably available throughout the working day where required for assigned marketing activities, communication, coordination and reporting.

Candidate Eligibility

Candidates with practical knowledge or experience in Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, SEO, Content Marketing or related areas are preferred.

\- Freshers with genuine practical marketing knowledge are welcome.

\- Good understanding of digital marketing and major social media platforms.

\- Basic knowledge of SEO, keyword research, content optimisation and organic marketing.

\- Ability to create professional written and visual B2B content.

\- Ability to effectively use free AI tools and technologies for marketing activities and productivity.

\- Ability to create or learn to create short\-form marketing videos and visual content using free tools.

\- Familiarity with Canva or similar free design tools is preferred.

\- Good written and verbal communication skills.

\- Creative thinking and ability to develop practical marketing ideas.

\- Ability to learn TradeInfra's business model, services and target audiences and apply marketing skills accordingly.

\- Strong self\-learning ability and willingness to continuously improve marketing skills.

\- Self\-motivated and capable of working independently in a startup environment.

\- Comfortable with performance\-based compensation.

\- Minimum Age: 18\+

\- Education: 12th / Graduation / Master's

\- Location: India

\- Work Mode: Work From Home

Company Support

The Company will provide the necessary business understanding, product/service information, marketing direction, operational guidance, SOPs and relevant training required to understand TradeInfra's business and target audiences.

The Executive will be expected to independently apply their marketing skills using available free digital platforms, free tools and AI technologies to produce measurable marketing results.

The objective is not simply to publish content. The objective is to build TradeInfra's digital presence, organic reach, credibility, lead generation and overall marketing impact among relevant Indian and international business audiences.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

description:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills as well as experience in advanced web searching
* Highly organized

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Hardworking and proactive
* Ability to work independently using creative thinking without extensive direction
* Strong work ethic and highly self\-motivated
* Positive team player attitude
* Willingness to work in **U.S. shifts**

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:


* The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up.
* Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company\-wide wellness days.

* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next\-generation workflow solutions, and client\-centric specialized support. As a member of the S\&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

title: Business Development Associate (BDA)
description:
**About Airtribe**

Airtribe is an AI\-first upskilling platform for working professionals. From Product Management to Backend Engineering, our programs are designed around real\-world use cases, AI tools, and hands\-on learning.

We work with instructors from companies like Microsoft, Meta, Razorpay, Coinbase, Gojek, and Uber, and have helped 5,000\+ professionals accelerate their careers.

Backed by Better Capital, 640 Ventures, and Kunal Shah, we are building a fast\-growing learning platform focused on real outcomes.

**The Context**

At Airtribe, Business Development is not about pushing sales. It is about helping working professionals make the right career decisions.

As we scale, the volume of learners and conversations increases, but maintaining trust, clarity, and quality in each interaction becomes harder. This role exists to ensure that every learner interaction is thoughtful, consultative, and outcome\-driven, not transactional.

**The Role**

As a Business Development Associate, you will work closely with learners to understand their goals and guide them toward the right programs. You will own the journey from the first conversation to final enrollment, ensuring clarity, trust, and a strong learner experience throughout.

This is a role built for people who are early in their careers and hungry to grow fast. We will give you the training, the environment, and the support. What we are looking for is the drive to make it count.

**What You'll Own**

* End\-to\-end learner conversations from first touchpoint to enrollment
* Understanding learner goals and guiding them with clarity and empathy
* Follow\-ups, objection handling, and decision support
* Maintaining quality and consistency across all interactions
* Accurate documentation of conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes
* Building relationships through calls, events, and networking opportunities

**What Problems You'll Solve**

* Helping learners make informed decisions instead of rushed choices
* Reducing drop\-offs caused by confusion or lack of clarity
* Building trust in a high\-volume, fast\-moving sales environment
* Ensuring conversations are consultative, not script\-driven

**How This Role Evolves**

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the product, learner personas, and running effective conversations.

Over time, you will be expected to improve conversion quality, handle more complex conversations, and contribute to refining sales processes.

Based on performance, this role can evolve into owning larger pipelines, mentoring junior team members, or moving into high\-impact sales or growth roles.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fresh graduates, freshers with internship experience, or candidates with up to 10 months of experience
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to build trust quickly and handle conversations with clarity
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Ownership mindset, proactive and accountable
* A genuine interest in sales and helping people make the right decisions

*Nice to have:*

* Prior internship or experience in sales, inside sales, or customer\-facing roles
* Exposure to edtech or consultative sales environments

**Compensation and Growth**

* During the 3\-month probation period, the salary will be Rs. 17,000 to 20,000 per month, plus incentives
* On successful confirmation, your fixed pay increases by 90% to 150%, along with incentives
* This is a performance\-driven role, and your growth here is directly tied to the impact you create

**What This Role Is Not** This is not a script\-driven or transactional sales role.

We are not looking for someone who pushes for closures. We are looking for someone who understands learners, builds trust, and helps them make the right decisions.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* High\-impact role with direct business visibility from day one
* A clear and fast growth path in a performance\-driven environment
* Significant salary growth on confirmation
* Collaborative and ambitious team culture
* Comprehensive medical insurance

At Airtribe, Business Development is about building trust and driving meaningful outcomes, not just closing deals.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Graphic Designer**
--------------------


**Location:** Pune


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Freshers with strong portfolios are encouraged to apply)


### **About the Role**



We’re looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Graphic Designer who can translate marketing ideas into strong visual communication across digital and print. You’ll work closely with the marketing, content, and video teams to create high\-impact visuals for social media, paid ads, email, WhatsApp, website, campaigns, events, packaging, and offline brand communication.


### **Key Responsibilities**


1\. Marketing \& Campaign Design
* Create compelling creatives for Meta, Google, social media, email, WhatsApp, and websites.
* Design campaign visuals, promotional assets, product communication, and marketing collateral.
* Adapt creative assets across different formats, platforms, and target audiences.

* Design brochures, flyers, standees, posters, banners, certificates, event collateral, and other print materials.

* Maintain consistent brand identity across all digital and offline touchpoints.
* Develop unique visual concepts based on creative briefs and marketing objectives.

4\. Collaboration \& Execution
* Collaborate with marketing and content teams to translate abstract ideas into concrete visual concepts.
* Work with video editors to create thumbnails, visual assets, and basic motion elements.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver high\-quality work within deadlines.

* 1–3 years of professional graphic design experience or a standout portfolio.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or equivalent industry\-standard tools.
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, color theory, and layout.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines.

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience in motion graphics or After Effects.
* Basic video editing skills.
* Understanding of UI/UX principles.
* Experience with 3D design software.
* Previous experience designing for performance marketing or D2C/e\-commerce brands.

description:
**Job Title**

  

**Territory Service Representative – Operations**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

  

  

**Reports To**

  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)  



  

**Location**

**25%** **50%** **75%** **þ**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations*** Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence*** Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration*** Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

**Education**:* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**  

**Technical Skills:*** Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

title: Business Development Associate (BDA)
description:
**Business Development Associate**

Location: Bangalore (On\-site)

Type: Full\-time (3\-Month Probation, then Confirmation)

Experience: Fresh graduates, freshers with internship experience, or up to 10 months of experience

**About Airtribe** Airtribe is an AI\-first upskilling platform for working professionals. From Product Management to Backend Engineering, our programs are designed around real\-world use cases, AI tools, and hands\-on learning.

We work with instructors from companies like Microsoft, Meta, Razorpay, Coinbase, Gojek, and Uber, and have helped 5,000\+ professionals accelerate their careers.

Backed by Better Capital, 640 Ventures, and Kunal Shah, we are building a fast\-growing learning platform focused on real outcomes.

**The Context** At Airtribe, Business Development is not about pushing sales. It is about helping working professionals make the right career decisions.

As we scale, the volume of learners and conversations increases, but maintaining trust, clarity, and quality in each interaction becomes harder. This role exists to ensure that every learner interaction is thoughtful, consultative, and outcome\-driven, not transactional.

**The Role** As a Business Development Associate, you will work closely with learners to understand their goals and guide them toward the right programs. You will own the journey from the first conversation to final enrollment, ensuring clarity, trust, and a strong learner experience throughout.

This is a role built for people who are early in their careers and hungry to grow fast. We will give you the training, the environment, and the support. What we are looking for is the drive to make it count.

**What You'll Own**

* End\-to\-end learner conversations from first touchpoint to enrollment
* Understanding learner goals and guiding them with clarity and empathy
* Follow\-ups, objection handling, and decision support
* Maintaining quality and consistency across all interactions
* Accurate documentation of conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes
* Building relationships through calls, events, and networking opportunities

**What Problems You'll Solve**

* Helping learners make informed decisions instead of rushed choices
* Reducing drop\-offs caused by confusion or lack of clarity
* Building trust in a high\-volume, fast\-moving sales environment
* Ensuring conversations are consultative, not script\-driven

**How This Role Evolves** In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the product, learner personas, and running effective conversations.

Over time, you will be expected to improve conversion quality, handle more complex conversations, and contribute to refining sales processes.

Based on performance, this role can evolve into owning larger pipelines, mentoring junior team members, or moving into high\-impact sales or growth roles.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fresh graduates, freshers with internship experience, or candidates with up to 10 months of experience
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to build trust quickly and handle conversations with clarity
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Ownership mindset, proactive and accountable
* A genuine interest in sales and helping people make the right decisions

*Nice to have:*

* Prior internship or experience in sales, inside sales, or customer\-facing roles
* Exposure to edtech or consultative sales environments

**Compensation and Growth**

* During the 3\-month probation period, the salary will be Rs. 17,000 to 20,000 per month, plus incentives
* On successful confirmation, your fixed pay increases by 90% to 150%, along with incentives
* This is a performance\-driven role, and your growth here is directly tied to the impact you create

**What This Role Is Not** This is not a script\-driven or transactional sales role.

We are not looking for someone who pushes for closures. We are looking for someone who understands learners, builds trust, and helps them make the right decisions.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* High\-impact role with direct business visibility from day one
* A clear and fast growth path in a performance\-driven environment
* Significant salary growth on confirmation
* Collaborative and ambitious team culture
* Comprehensive medical insurance

At Airtribe, Business Development is about building trust and driving meaningful outcomes, not just closing deals.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Job Description — Mechanical Design Engineer

About Motorall

Motorall is developing next\-generation autonomous mobility and material\-handling systems for warehouses, ports, mining and industrial logistics.

Our product portfolio includes **Cyborg autonomous mobile robots for 200–1,000 kg payloads**, as well as **T\-REX heavy\-duty autonomous vehicles designed for 20–50 tonne cargo movement** across ports, mines and industrial environments.  
Motorall is building integrated robotic platforms combining **mechanical systems, electric powertrains, drive\-by\-wire, sensors, autonomy, fleet management and industrial vehicle architecture**.

We are looking for a highly capable **Mechanical Design Engineer** who can take ownership of the mechanical architecture of our robots and electric vehicles—from concept and CAD through prototyping, testing and deployment.

Role Overview

This is a **hands\-on product\-development role**, not a conventional CAD\-design position.

The selected engineer will work on the design and development of:

* Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs)
* Heavy\-duty autonomous ground vehicles
* Electric/hybrid powertrain systems
* Chassis and structural systems
* Drive systems and wheel\-end assemblies
* Battery\-pack integration
* Steering, suspension and braking systems
* Robotic mechanisms and payload interfaces
* Modular robot platforms
* Trailer/cargo coupling mechanisms
* Mechanical systems for industrial and port environments

The engineer will work closely with electrical, electronics, controls, autonomy and manufacturing teams to develop complete working robotic vehicles.

Key Responsibilities1\. Robot Mechanical Design

* Design complete mechanical architectures for autonomous mobile robots.
* Develop chassis, frame, body, payload decks and structural members.
* Design mounting systems for LiDAR, cameras, radar, batteries, motors, controllers and other sensors/electronics.
* Design mechanical interfaces for conveyor, flatbed, lift and robotic\-arm top modules.
* Develop modular robot architectures that can be adapted for different payloads and applications.
* Design mechanisms for loading, unloading, docking and material handling.
* Design mechanical safety systems, guards, bumpers and protective structures.
* Develop mechanisms for autonomous docking and vehicle positioning.

Motorall's Cyborg platform is designed for 200–1,000 kg payloads and supports modular top modules including conveyors, flatbeds, lifts and robotic\-arm integration.

2\. Heavy Electric Vehicle Design

* Develop mechanical architecture for large electric autonomous vehicles.
* Design heavy\-duty chassis and structural systems for high\-payload applications.
* Develop drivetrain layouts for electric/hybrid vehicles.
* Work on motor, gearbox, differential, axle and wheel\-end integration.
* Design mounting systems for traction motors and power electronics.
* Perform mechanical integration of battery packs and high\-voltage components.
* Design systems for serviceability, maintenance and component replacement.
* Support development of vehicles intended for continuous 24/7 industrial operation.

The T\-REX platform is intended for 20–50 tonne cargo handling and uses an electric/hybrid powertrain architecture for port, mining, construction and heavy\-industrial applications.

3\. EV Powertrain Development

The candidate should be capable of working on the complete mechanical side of an EV powertrain.

Responsibilities may include:

* Traction motor integration
* Gearbox/reduction\-stage integration
* Differential and axle integration
* Driveshaft and coupling design
* Wheel\-end design
* Torque and load calculations
* Gear ratio selection and mechanical validation
* Bearing and shaft selection
* Powertrain mounting
* Structural analysis of drivetrain components
* Thermal\-management packaging
* Battery\-to\-powertrain mechanical integration
* Mechanical protection of high\-voltage systems

Experience with **BLDC, PMSM, induction or other electric traction motors** will be advantageous.

4\. CAD \& Product Design

The engineer will be expected to independently create and manage production\-ready CAD.

Responsibilities include:

* 3D part modelling
* Assembly modelling
* Detailed engineering drawings
* GD\&T
* Tolerance stack\-up
* Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
* Design for Assembly (DFA)
* Sheet\-metal design
* Welded\-frame design
* Machined\-component design
* Fabrication drawings
* BOM generation
* Engineering change management

5\. Autonomous Robot Integration

The mechanical engineer will work alongside the autonomy and electronics teams to ensure that mechanical architecture supports autonomous operation.

This includes:

* Sensor mounting and protection
* LiDAR/camera/radar mounting
* Sensor field\-of\-view considerations
* Drive\-by\-wire mechanical interfaces
* Steering actuator integration
* Brake actuator integration
* Motor/controller packaging
* Battery and electronics enclosure design
* Cable\-routing provisions
* Service access
* Emergency\-stop and safety\-system integration

Experience

**2–6 years of relevant professional/project experience.**

Freshers should generally not be considered unless they have exceptionally strong hands\-on experience through major robotics/EV projects, Formula Student, Baja, autonomous vehicle projects, research projects or demonstrated product development.

The ideal candidate will have previously worked on at least one of:

* AMR/AGV/UGV
* Electric vehicle
* Autonomous vehicle
* Heavy machinery
* Automotive powertrain
* Robotics platform
* Industrial machine
* Mobile robotics

The ideal candidate should:

* Think from first principles.
* Understand how a machine actually moves and carries load.
* Be comfortable with both equations and CAD.
* Be able to take a concept from a blank screen to a physical prototype.
* Understand the difference between a laboratory prototype and a deployable industrial machine.
* Be comfortable working with manufacturing teams.
* Be willing to physically inspect and troubleshoot machines.
* Have strong ownership and execution ability.
* Be capable of independently driving a mechanical subsystem from concept to validation.

Advantageous Additional Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following will receive preference:

* Formula Student
* SAE Baja
* Autonomous vehicle competitions
* IIT robotics projects
* Electric vehicle projects
* Heavy\-duty vehicle design

* Design optimization
* Rapid prototyping
* 3D printing
* Embedded hardware packaging

**Portfolio\-based evaluation will be an important part of the selection process.**

Offshore Marketers is a data\-driven digital marketing agency focused on delivering performance\-oriented solutions across SEO, paid ads, funnels, and automation. We are currently seeking a **Business Developer** with the experience of 1\+ Year who can bridge business needs with technical execution, helping us scale smarter and drive growth using insights, systems, and strategy.

**Role Overview:**

As a Business Developer, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams—including marketing, sales, and tech—to identify business opportunities, optimize workflows, and support data\-driven decision\-making. This role is ideal for someone who understands digital marketing ecosystems and wants to contribute strategically to business and product development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Business Requirement Gathering:** Work with stakeholders to collect, define, and translate business needs into functional requirements and project documentation.
* **Lead Funnel Analysis:** Analyze lead generation funnels and user journeys to identify bottlenecks, conversion drop\-offs, and opportunities for optimization using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, and CRM dashboards.
* **Lead Generation \& Revenue Contribution:** Strategically identify and utilize various online portals to generate qualified leads, nurture opportunities, and contribute directly to the company’s revenue pipeline.
* **Client Needs Mapping:** Conduct discovery calls and align client objectives with internal capabilities, translating business goals into measurable KPIs and performance metrics.
* **Market \& Competitive Intelligence:** Perform competitor benchmarking, trend forecasting, and audience segmentation using research platforms and data visualization tools.
* **Proposal \& SOW Documentation:** Create business proposals, technical documentation, and scope of work documents using a structured, data\-backed approach.
* **CRM \& Data Management:** Maintain data integrity within CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), generate reports, and build dashboards to track business development performance.
* **Process Automation Support:** Identify areas for workflow automation using tools like Zapier, Make (Integromat), or CRM\-native automation features.
* **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Act as the liaison between business, marketing, and technical teams to ensure successful implementation of growth and campaign strategies.

**Technical \& Core Skills Required:**

* **Basic Analytical Tools:** Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for reporting and simple data analysis (e.g., filters, charts, basic formulas).
* **CRM Familiarity:** Hands\-on experience or basic understanding of any CRM platform like Zoho, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel to manage leads and track client interactions.
* **Digital Marketing Awareness:** General understanding of how online funnels, paid ads, and email campaigns work. Experience working with teams using tools like MailerLite, Meta Ads Manager, or Systeme.io is a plus.
* **Documentation Skills:** Ability to create structured documents such as client briefs, simple reports, and workflow outlines using MS Word, Google Docs, or Notion.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills for coordinating with team members and presenting findings or suggestions clearly.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to identify issues, think critically, and suggest practical solutions based on available data.
* **Organizational Tools:** Comfortable using basic project management tools like Trello, ClickUp, or Google Calendar to manage tasks and timelines.
