title: Workday HRIS Specialist, Senior Principal ( Advanced Compensation and Integrations)
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) \- the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI\-powered applications and experience with agility and ease.


We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **HRIS Specialist, Senior Principal** and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Learn More about **us**


We are hiring an experienced Workday Technical and Functional Consultant to act as the single point of contact between our HR, Finance, IT and business stakeholders and the Workday delivery team. This is a hands\-on configuration role, not a program management role: the successful candidate will have spent the last 10 years working inside Workday tenants, configuring solutions, building and troubleshooting integrations, and producing reporting that leaders actually use.


The role sits at the center of demand and delivery. Requests arrive from many directions and in many forms, from a one\-line question about an eligibility rule to a multi\-quarter programme of work. This person translates those requests into clear problem statements, sizes them honestly, and then distributes the work across the full delivery group, which spans our internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant. Part of that judgement is deciding at the point of intake which items should sit with the consultant from the start rather than being picked up internally and handed over later. Equally important is the ability to explain the resulting design back to the requesting team in plain business language, and to the delivery group in configuration terms.

**In This role, you will :**

**Stakeholder Engagement and Requirement Intake**

* Serve as the single point of contact for all stakeholder groups raising Workday demand, running a consistent intake process rather than an ad hoc queue.
* Gather, challenge and document requirements from HR, Payroll, Finance, IT and business leaders, converting loosely worded asks into precise, testable problem statements.
* Translate business problem statements into functional and technical design for the team, and translate proposed Workday solutions back into language the requesting team can validate and sign off.
* Maintain a single prioritized demand backlog, agree sequencing with stakeholders, and communicate trade\-offs when capacity is constrained.
* Run design walkthroughs, impact assessments and readiness sessions ahead of each Workday release.

**Configuration and Solution Design**

* Own end\-to\-end configuration design across the Workday footprint, working hands\-on in the tenant rather than directing others from a distance.
* Configure and troubleshoot business processes, condition rules, security groups, domain and business process security policies, calculated fields and eligibility rules.
* Assess downstream impact of every change across modules before it is built, and protect tenant hygiene through disciplined use of sandbox, sandbox preview and production migration practices.
* Define and enforce configuration standards, naming conventions, testing expectations and documentation for the team.

**Integrations and Reporting**

* Design, build and support integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio and web services, including error handling, monitoring and re\-run procedures.
* Act as the technical authority on integration issues raised by vendors and downstream system owners, and drive root cause analysis to closure.
* Build advanced, matrix, composite reporting, and advise stakeholders on the right reporting approach rather than building every request as asked.
* Ensure reporting and integration outputs respect data privacy, segregation of duties and audit requirements.

**Work Sizing, Prioritization and Distribution**

* Assess the complexity, risk and effort of each incoming requirement and assign it to the right owner across the delivery group, which includes internal HRIS team members and our Workday consultant.
* Balance workload across internal team members and consultant capacity, track progress against commitments, and escalate early when a commitment is at risk.
* Review the work of internal team members and the consultant, provide technical coaching, and raise the overall configuration capability of the group.

**Sourcing Decisions at Intake**

* Decide at the point of intake, rather than mid\-delivery, which items should go to the consultant from the start and which the internal HRIS team should own, based on complexity, specialist skill requirements, timeline pressure and internal capacity.
* Prepare scope and requirement documentation for consultant\-delivered work, review the designs and deliverables that come back, and hold the consultant to quality and timeline expectations.
* Track the split between internal and consultant delivery, and advise leadership on where that boundary should sit as internal capability grows.

**Subject Matter Expertise Required**


The candidate must demonstrate working familiarity with all Workday modules in our footprint and deep, demonstrable subject matter expertise in the following two areas:

* **Advanced Compensation**, including compensation and merit plan configuration, eligibility rules, compensation review cycles, bonus and stock processes, matrices and worksheet configuration, and troubleshooting cycle issues under time pressure.
* **Integrations**, including EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, web services, integration security configuration, and the operational support model that keeps integrations running.

**Your Background :**

* Overall 12\+ years of experience in HR Systems**.** ***Minimum 10 years of experience working exclusively on the Workday configuration side, in a technical and functional consulting or in\-house product capacity.***
* Working knowledge of all Workday modules, with the ability to reason about cross\-module impact rather than treating each module in isolation.
* Subject matter expertise in **Advanced Compensation and Integrations**, evidenced by full\-lifecycle delivery in both.
* Strong reporting capability across advanced, matrix, composite reporting, and comfort with calculated fields.
* Proven experience as the requirements owner or single point of contact for a stakeholder community, including prioritization and expectation management with senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to size and distribute work across a mixed\-seniority team, and to decide at intake which work belongs with internal team members and which with an external consultant.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical design to non\-technical audiences and business intent to technical colleagues.
* Willingness to work the **1:00 pm to 10:00 pm shift** and to be present in the **Bengaluru or Hyderabad office two days per week.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro certification or partner certification in Compensation, Advanced Compensation or Integrations.
* Experience supporting a global workforce across multiple regions and regulatory environments.
* Experience operating within a shared services or HR technology centre of excellence model.
* Familiarity with ticketing and demand management tooling, and with release governance for Workday feature releases.

**If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we’d be happy to chat. What we offer in return is the opportunity to experience a great** **company culture** **with wonderful colleagues to learn from and collaborate with, and also to enjoy:**  

  

**Compensation**

* Competitive remuneration package
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan Enrolment

**Vacation, Family, and Health**

* 30 days of earned leave
* An extra day off for your birthday
* Various other leaves like marriage leave, casual leave, maternity leave, and paternity leave
* Premium Group Medical Insurance for employees and five dependents, personal accident insurance coverage, and life insurance coverage
* Professional development reimbursement
* Interest subsidy on loans \- either vehicle or personal loans.

**Apply now!**

**\#LI\-SR1**

description:
About Rolvatech

**Rolvatech is expanding into a new business wing focused on technology staffing and workforce augmentation**, helping businesses quickly access skilled technology professionals for their hiring and project requirements.

As part of this new initiative, Rolvatech is building a dedicated **IT Staffing \& Staff Augmentation practice** focused on connecting organisations with pre\-vetted technology professionals. Our objective is to help clients reduce hiring timelines, improve access to quality talent, and scale their technology teams efficiently.

Our talent pool covers **Software Development, Cloud \& DevOps, Data \& Analytics, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, QA, Salesforce, ServiceNow**, and other specialised technology domains.

The new initiative will primarily focus on the **Australian and Indian markets**.

Position: Client Acquisition Consultant

**Engagement Type:** Fixed One\-Time Incentive  
**Work Model:** Remote / Flexible  
**Target Markets:** Australia \& India  
**Industry:** IT Staffing \& Workforce Augmentation

About the Role

We are looking for an **experienced Client Acquisition Consultant** with proven experience working in the **Australian and/or Indian IT staffing market**.

The role is specifically focused on **acquiring and onboarding new clients** for Rolvatech's IT staffing and staff augmentation services.

This is **not a full\-time salaried position**. The consultant will work on a flexible, performance\-based engagement and will receive a **fixed one\-time payment for each successfully onboarded client**.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify organisations with IT staffing, technology hiring, or workforce augmentation requirements.
* Leverage existing relationships with **HR, Talent Acquisition, Procurement, IT, and business decision\-makers**.
* Approach and engage potential clients in the Australian and Indian markets.
* Generate genuine and qualified client opportunities.
* Introduce Rolvatech's IT staffing and staff augmentation capabilities.
* Arrange meetings between prospective clients and the Rolvatech team.
* Support the prospect through the client onboarding process.
* Establish new client and vendor relationships.
* Build a pipeline of organisations requiring technology professionals.

Working Requirements Provided

Rolvatech will provide the consultant with the necessary **job requirements, technology skill requirements, service information, company details, and supporting material** required for client discussions.

The consultant's primary responsibility will be **client acquisition and onboarding**, while Rolvatech's internal team will support recruitment and delivery.

What Qualifies as a Successful Client Acquisition?

A client will be considered successfully acquired when:

**Prospect Identified → Decision\-Maker Engaged → Business Discussion → Client Onboarding → Genuine Staffing Requirement / Active Engagement**

Simply providing company names, contact details, databases, or unqualified leads will **not** qualify for the incentive.

Compensation

**Fixed One\-Time Payment Per Successfully Onboarded Client**

* Fixed payment for every successfully onboarded client.
* Payment will be made once the agreed client onboarding criteria are successfully completed.
* **No percentage\-based revenue sharing.**
* **No recurring commission.**
* No ongoing share of revenue or profit generated from the client.
* Higher fixed incentives may be considered for strategic or enterprise\-level clients.

Ideal Candidate

We are specifically looking for experienced professionals with:

* Proven experience in **IT staffing, recruitment sales, client acquisition, or business development**.
* Strong understanding of the **Australian and/or Indian IT staffing market**.
* An existing network of potential clients or decision\-makers.
* Experience engaging with **HR Managers, Talent Acquisition Managers, Procurement Teams, Hiring Managers, CIOs, CTOs, or business leaders**.
* Strong B2B sales and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to convert prospects into genuine business relationships.
* Experience with technology staffing or workforce augmentation will be highly preferred.

Why Join This Initiative?

* Work remotely with flexible working arrangements.
* No traditional full\-time employment commitment.
* Focus exclusively on **client acquisition**.
* Staffing and technology requirements will be provided by Rolvatech.
* **Fixed one\-time incentive for every successfully onboarded client.**
* No revenue\-sharing or long\-term commission arrangement.
* Opportunity to work with a growing technology staffing and augmentation practice.

Important

This is a **client acquisition\-focused opportunity**, not a recruitment delivery role.

You will not be responsible for managing the complete recruitment process. Once a client is successfully onboarded, **Rolvatech's internal recruitment and delivery team will manage the staffing requirements and candidate fulfilment**.

Interested candidates can **share their resume at jegan@rolvatech.com** with the subject line:

**Client Acquisition Consultant – Australia \& India**

**If you have proven experience acquiring IT staffing clients in Australia or India and have an established business network, we would like to hear from you.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

description:
We are looking for a **SEO Analyst** to improve our website’s organic search visibility, rankings, traffic, and lead generation. The candidate will be responsible for conducting keyword research, implementing on\-page and off\-page SEO strategies, monitoring website performance, and identifying opportunities to improve search engine rankings.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct **keyword research and competitor analysis** to identify SEO opportunities.
* Optimize website content, landing pages, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal links.
* Monitor and improve **organic search rankings, traffic, conversions, and engagement**.
* Perform regular **technical SEO audits** and identify issues affecting website performance.
* Manage SEO activities including on\-page, off\-page, local, and technical SEO.
* Develop and execute **link\-building and backlink acquisition strategies**.

* Analyze Google Search Console and Google Analytics data to identify trends and opportunities.

* Identify and resolve issues related to **indexing, crawlability, broken links, duplicate content, and website structure**.
* Stay updated with Google algorithm changes, SEO trends, and industry best practices.
* Coordinate with web developers, content teams, and digital marketing teams to implement SEO recommendations.
* Conduct competitor SEO analysis and benchmark website performance.
* Improve website visibility for relevant keywords and increase qualified organic leads.

* Strong knowledge of **SEO principles and best practices**.
* Experience with **Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Keyword Planner**.
* Knowledge of SEO tools such as **SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Screaming Frog**, or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of keyword research and search intent.
* Knowledge of on\-page and technical SEO.
* Basic understanding of HTML, website structure, and content management systems such as WordPress.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to analyze data and prepare performance reports.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in **Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, IT, Communications**, or a related field.
* **1–3 years of experience** in SEO or digital marketing preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Organic website traffic growth

* Organic leads and conversions

* Organic conversion rate

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Post: Electrical Engineer – Integrated Steel Plant

**Job Title:** Electrical Engineer – Steel Plant  
**Experience:** Fresher to 2 years  
**Qualification:** Diploma/B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical or Electrical \& Electronics Engineering  
**Department:** Electrical Maintenance / Projects / Operations  
**Location:** \[Insert location]  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Assistant Manager / Manager – Electrical Maintenance

About the role

We are hiring Electrical Engineers to support the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems in an integrated steel plant. The selected candidates will work on electrical maintenance, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, commissioning and improvement of plant power\-distribution and control systems.

The role may cover raw\-material handling, coke oven, sinter plant, blast furnace, steel melting shop, continuous casting, rolling mill, utilities, captive power and material\-handling systems. Typical steel\-plant electrical work includes maintenance of motors, drives, substations, PLCs, control panels, power\-distribution systems and process equipment.rajuristeels\+1

Key responsibilitiesFor freshers

* Assist senior engineers in preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance.
* Inspect motors, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, PCCs, control panels and distribution systems.
* Support maintenance of LT and HT motors, pumps, fans, conveyors, cranes and other plant equipment.
* Assist in checking cable terminations, earthing, fuses, relays, contactors and overload\-protection devices.
* Help troubleshoot electrical faults under the supervision of experienced engineers.
* Support inspection of VFDs, soft starters, starters, PLC panels and instrumentation interfaces.
* Assist with testing of insulation resistance, continuity, earth resistance and motor condition.
* Participate in planned shutdowns, emergency maintenance and equipment commissioning.
* Read single\-line diagrams, control schematics, wiring diagrams and equipment manuals.
* Maintain inspection checklists, work permits, maintenance logs and breakdown reports.
* Coordinate with mechanical, instrumentation, production, utility and safety teams.
* Support energy\-saving, 5S, housekeeping and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Follow electrical isolation, lockout/tagout and permit\-to\-work procedures.

For candidates with 1–2 years’ experience

* Plan and execute preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance of plant electrical systems.
* Troubleshoot HT/LT motors, MCCs, PCCs, transformers, switchgear, VFDs, soft starters and control circuits.
* Maintain electrical systems for conveyors, crushers, pumps, fans, cranes, rolling mills and continuous\-casting equipment.
* Monitor electrical parameters such as current, voltage, load, power factor and motor temperature.
* Coordinate inspection and maintenance of substations, transformers, protection systems and power\-distribution equipment.
* Support PLC, SCADA, HMI and automation fault diagnosis in coordination with the instrumentation team.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly preventive\-maintenance schedules.
* Execute shutdown and turnaround maintenance within the approved safety and time requirements.
* Conduct failure analysis and root\-cause analysis for repeated electrical breakdowns.
* Recommend equipment modifications and reliability\-improvement measures.
* Supervise electricians, technicians, contractors and service agencies.
* Prepare maintenance reports, job cards, test records, equipment history and spare requirements.
* Assist in electrical estimation, procurement, inspection and inventory control of critical spares.
* Support new equipment installation, testing, energization and commissioning.
* Coordinate with operations before electrical switching, isolation and restoration of supply.
* Monitor maintenance KPIs such as equipment availability, downtime, PM compliance and repeat failures.

Electrical maintenance roles commonly include planned and reactive maintenance, fault diagnosis, technician coordination, maintenance documentation and strict isolation procedures. Industrial roles may also involve shutdown maintenance, spare\-parts planning, motor testing and workshop coordination.app.jobitus\+1

Equipment and system exposure

The engineer may work on:

* HT and LT substations.
* Transformers, circuit breakers, isolators and protection relays.
* PCCs, MCCs, APFC panels and distribution boards.
* LT and HT motors, generators and emergency power systems.
* VFDs, soft starters and motor\-control circuits.
* PLC, SCADA, HMI and industrial communication systems.
* Conveyors, crushers, screens, feeders and stacker\-reclaimers.
* Pumps, fans, compressors, blowers and hydraulic power units.
* Cranes, hoists and material\-handling equipment.
* Rolling\-mill drives and control systems.
* Continuous\-casting electrical and control systems.
* Plant lighting, emergency systems, UPS and battery chargers.
* Earthing, lightning protection and cable\-tray systems.

Safety responsibilities

* Follow all electrical safety rules, PPE requirements and permit systems.
* Ensure proper isolation, discharge, earthing and lockout/tagout before starting work.
* Verify absence of voltage before handling electrical equipment.
* Follow safe practices for HT switching, electrical testing and work at height.
* Conduct toolbox talks and job\-safety analysis before critical work.
* Inspect tools, test instruments, cables and lifting equipment before use.
* Report unsafe conditions, near misses, electrical hazards and incidents.

title: Cloud Security Analyst
description:
**Cloud Security Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, safer AI systems — and we need practitioners who truly understand how cloud environments fail in the real world.
   

  

 If you've spent time in the trenches of AWS, GCP, or Azure and you know what a misconfigured IAM policy or an exposed storage bucket actually means for a business, this role was built for you. Your expertise will directly shape how AI reasons about cloud security — making these systems more accurate, more realistic, and more useful.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze cloud security scenarios across AWS, GCP, and Azure to identify risks and realistic failure patterns
* Review IAM configurations, network architectures, storage permissions, and container security setups
* Classify security gaps, misconfigurations, and cloud incidents based on real\-world impact and blast radius
* Validate and improve AI\-generated security reasoning so it reflects how cloud incidents actually unfold
* Help build datasets and evaluations that push the frontier of AI security capabilities


**Who You Are**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience working with cloud environments in production
* Solid understanding of cloud IAM, networking, storage, and container security across major providers
* Familiar with real\-world misconfigurations and how they escalate into incidents
* Able to reason clearly about blast radius, risk exposure, and business impact
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task\-based assignments


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with cloud security tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, AWS Security Hub)
* Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or incident response
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, or NIST
* Security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, CISSP, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Meaningful work that improves how AI understands real\-world security
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Intern Contractual Network Security Engineer
description:
**Role Type:** Contractual Internship transitioning to Full\-Time Probation (Performance\-Based)

**Qualification:** B.Tech / B.E. (Any Stream)

**Experience Level:** 0 – 1 Year (Freshers with strong networking foundations welcome)

​Position Overview

​We are seeking dedicated, tech\-savvy, and high\-energy **Intern Network Security Engineers** to join our core technical team. This program is structured as an intensive training\-cum\-evaluation initiative where selected candidates will gain hands\-on operational exposure to enterprise routing, switching, VPN technologies, and network security infrastructure.

​Program Structure \& Career Progression\+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\+\| PHASE 1: Contractual Training \& Evaluation (4 Months) \|\| **Stipend: INR 11,000 / Month (Monthly Invoice Basis) \|\|**  Cohort: 8–10 Engineers \|\+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\+ \| v (Selection of Top 4–6 Performers)\+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\+\| PHASE 2: Core Engineering Probation (6 Months) \|\| **Fixed Salary: INR 22,500 / Month \|\|**  Role: Full\-fledged Network Security Engineer \|\+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\+

* **Phase 1: Contractual Internship \& Technical Training (Months 1 to 4\)**
* ​**Cohort Size:** 8–10 Engineers.
* ​**Compensation:** **INR 11,000/\- per month**, disbursed upon submission of monthly invoices.
* ​**Focus:** Intensive hands\-on training, lab simulations, live deployment shadowing, and performance evaluations.
* ​**Phase 2: Full\-Time Probation (Months 5 to 10\)**
* ​**Selection:** Based on performance evaluations at the end of Month 4, top **4–6 performers** will be selected for permanent onboarding onto probation.
* ​**Compensation:** Established salary of **INR 22,500/\- per month**.
* ​**Focus:** Live network security management, client deployments, and incident response.

​Roles \& Responsibilities

* ​Configure, test, and troubleshoot enterprise\-grade routers, switches, and network appliances.
* ​Implement and manage basic and advanced network services, including **DNS, DHCP, Static IP allocation, Subnetting, and SNMP**.
* ​Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot dynamic routing protocols (**OSPF, BGP, IS\-IS, RIP**) and multicast routing (**PIM**).
* ​Configure Layer 2 and Layer 3 segmentation, including **VLANs, VxLAN, and VRF** environments.
* ​Deploy, test, and manage secure remote access solutions including **SSL VPN** and **IPSec VPN** (both Site\-to\-Site and Client\-to\-Site configurations).
* ​Monitor network uptime, system performance, and device health via **SNMP** monitoring tools.
* ​Assist senior security architects in deploying firewall policies, threat monitoring, and infrastructure hardening.

​Technical Requirements \& Qualifications​Educational Background

* ​**B.Tech / B.E.** in any stream (Computer Science, IT, Electronics \& Communication, or related engineering fields preferred).

​Core Technical Must\-Haves

* ​**Fundamental Networking:** Strong understanding of TCP/IP stack, Subnetting, DNS, DHCP, and Static IP configuration.
* ​**Hands\-on Router \& Switch Configuration:** Practical experience or hands\-on lab knowledge with enterprise routers and switches.
* ​**Routing Protocols:** Knowledge of OSPF, BGP, IS\-IS, RIP, and PIM.
* ​**Network Virtualization \& Isolation:** Practical/Theoretical understanding of VLANs, VxLAN, and VRF.
* ​**VPN Technologies:** Strong fundamentals in IPSec VPN (Site\-to\-Site \& Client\-to\-Site) and SSL VPN deployments.
* ​**Monitoring Systems:** Knowledge of **SNMP** (Simple Network Management Protocol) is **mandatory**.

​Additional Advantage (Good\-to\-Have)

* ​**6 Months to 1 Year** of prior hands\-on experience in **Firewall Configuration** (e.g., OPNsense, Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, or open\-source firewall platforms).
* ​CCNA or equivalent networking certification (In\-progress or completed).

​Key Competencies \& Soft Skills

* ​Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* ​High eagerness to learn complex network security concepts under guidance.
* ​Ability to work in a fast\-paced team environment and meet project deliverables.
* ​Good verbal and written communication skills for technical reporting and documentation.

These People Should be Ready for Field Support or Online Support, 6 Day Working Weeks on Rotation Basis (Roaster).

We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.  

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.  

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.  

  

If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.  

  

Position Overview:  

The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.  

Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.  

Job Purpose:  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:  

Pickup \& Delivery Operations* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.

* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.

* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.

* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.

* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

  

Customer Service Excellence* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.

* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.

* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.

* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.

* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

  

COD \& Documentation Management* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.

* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.

* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.

* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.

* Report discrepancies immediately.

  

Operational Compliance* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.

* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.

* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.

* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

  

Safety \& Security* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.

* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.

* Protect company assets and customer property.

  

Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.

* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.

* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.

* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.

* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.

* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.

* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.

* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.

* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:  

Education:* Minimum 8th Standard Pass.

* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.

* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.

* Valid Two\-Wheeler or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.

* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.

* Physically fit to perform field operations.

* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:  

Technical Skills:* Pickup \& Delivery Operations

* Shipment Handling

* Cash Collection (COD)

* Proof of Delivery (POD)

* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage

* Route Familiarity

* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills

* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

  

Key Competencies:* Customer Focus

* Integrity

* Reliability

* Safety Consciousness

* Teamwork

* Discipline

* Time Management

* Accountability

* Positive Attitude

* Professional Appearance

  

Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs  

KPIs  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity  

Service Quality  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction  

COD \& Documentation  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors  

Safety \& Compliance  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance  

Operational Productivity  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.  

Here’s what makes us stand out:  

Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.
This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

**Job Title**

  

**Territory Service Representative – Operations**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)  



  

**Location**

  

**Branch / Service Centre (Location Agnostic)**

  

  

**Travel Required**

  

**25%** **50%** **75%** **þ**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

description:
**Company Description**  

Engineering the AI\-powered enterprise. With AI and cloud\-native solutions, BETSOL accelerates cloud transformation for enterprises across 17\+ countries. BETSOL holds several engineering patents, and is recognized with industry awards. BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.


BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and delivers best\-in\-class performance.


BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end\-to\-end enterprise solutions, reducing time\-to\-market for customers.


BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore \& Belagavi, India.


We take pride in being an employee\-centric organization, offering comprehensive benefits and opportunities.


Learn more at betsol.com

 **Job Description** **About the Role**


The Customer Support Executive (CSE) is responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and professional customer support through voice and chat channels for U.S.\-based customers. This role focuses on resolving customer queries efficiently, ensuring high customer satisfaction, and adhering to defined support processes and service standards.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide timely and effective resolution to customer queries via voice and chat support
* Respond to customers in a professional, empathetic, and solution\-oriented manner
* Handle simple to complex customer issues and ensure first\-time resolution where possible
* Escalate issues to the appropriate teams within the defined Line of Business (LOB) when required
* Meet productivity, quality, and performance metrics as defined by the process or manager
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and quality guidelines
* Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions and resolutions
* Focus on achieving high customer satisfaction levels and service quality benchmarks
* Be flexible to work extended hours during high\-volume periods, when required
* Perform additional tasks as assigned in line with business needs

**Looking For**

* 1\-2 years of experience supporting US\-based customers through voice or chat processes; freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to learn are also encouraged to apply.

**Mandatory Skills**

**A. Technical / Functional Skills**

* Experience in Customer Support / Contact Center / Voice or Chat Process
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve customer queries effectively
* Experience handling service metrics and adherence to SLAs

**B. Soft Skills**

* Customer\-focused mindset with strong problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills (English)
* Self\-motivated and ability to work with minimal supervision
* Ability to remain calm and composed in high\-pressure situations
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of tasks

**Good to Have Skills**

* Prior experience in US voice support
* Exposure to CRM or ticketing tools
* Experience working in global support environments

 **Qualifications*** Graduate in any discipline
* Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education

 **Additional Information*** 5 working days per week
* 2 rotational weekly offs (not necessarily Saturday/Sunday)
* Willingness to work US time zones / rotational shifts
* Flexibility to extend working hours during business peak periods

About Us: Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R\&D. We design and manufacture high\-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading\-edge telecom products for building end\-to\-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99\.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O\-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS\-PON), carrier\-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct\-to\-Mobile and Satellite\-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R\&D\-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long\-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R\&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.


**Diversity and Inclusion Statement:**

* Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees.
* We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status.
* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.

  
About the Team: At Tejas Networks, product development is driven by a comprehensive lifecycle approach that begins with understanding customer and network requirements, followed by competitive analysis, architectural design, and implementation. This process emphasizes performance, scalability, cost\-efficiency, and environmental considerations, culminating in deployment and operational support. The technology portfolio spans diverse networking domains, including optical transport (DWDM, OTN), broadband access (GPON, XGSPON, CPON), service provider routing (IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, MPLS\-TP), and enterprise switching (L2/L3\). Products range from compact systems to complex, multi\-terabit, chassis\-based platforms designed for high availability, modularity, and scalability. Development involves specialized skills across hardware, firmware, FPGA, software, and synchronization, enabling teams to address multidisciplinary challenges effectively. Supporting these engineering efforts there is a centralized operational framework that provides strategic direction, governance, and essential services across the organization. This includes financial management, talent development, compliance, branding, innovation, risk management, and CSR. Together, these functions ensure seamless execution, alignment with business goals, and a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.

title: IP Admin Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

 **Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com , BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

 **It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

 **What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

 **About the Team**

  

The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

 **Hours of Work**

* This is a full\-time role requiring 40 working hours per week based out of Noida, India (IST).
* Work Mode\-Hybrid as per Clarivate location


At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

title: Receptionist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HOSPITAL RECEPTIONIST

**Hospital:** Vighnaharta Super Speciality Hospital  
**Location:** Keshavnagar, Mundhwa, Pune  
**Department:** Front Office / Administration  
**Position:** Hospital Receptionist  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Front Office Manager / Hospital Administrator

1\. Job Summary

The Hospital Receptionist will be responsible for managing the hospital front desk, welcoming patients and visitors, handling enquiries, assisting with appointments and registrations, and ensuring smooth coordination between patients and hospital departments. The receptionist should have excellent communication skills, a professional attitude, and the ability to work in a busy hospital environment.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Welcome and assist patients, attendants, visitors, and doctors professionally.
* Handle front\-desk enquiries and provide accurate information about hospital services.
* Register new and existing patients in the hospital system.
* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and cancel appointments.
* Manage OPD registration and guide patients to the appropriate department/doctor.
* Answer and transfer incoming telephone calls appropriately.
* Handle patient and visitor queries politely and efficiently.
* Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, billing, laboratory, radiology, pharmacy, and other departments.
* Assist patients with admission and discharge\-related formalities when required.
* Maintain accurate patient records and front\-office documentation.
* Handle hospital forms, registers, receipts, and other administrative documents.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information and hospital records.
* Inform patients about consultation timings, waiting procedures, and hospital facilities.
* Manage visitor flow and ensure proper communication with concerned departments.
* Handle complaints professionally and escalate serious issues to the concerned senior.
* Maintain cleanliness, discipline, and professional appearance at the reception area.
* Follow hospital policies, procedures, and patient\-safety guidelines.
* Perform other front\-office and administrative duties assigned by management.

3\. Required Qualifications

* Minimum **12th Pass**; Graduate preferred.
* Diploma/Certificate in Hospital Administration or Front Office Management will be an advantage.
* Previous experience as a hospital receptionist/front\-office executive is preferred.
* Freshers with good communication skills may also be considered.

4\. Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Polite, patient, and professional behaviour.
* Basic computer knowledge and MS Office skills.
* Knowledge of hospital management software/HMIS is preferred.
* Good English, Hindi, and Marathi communication skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks during busy hours.
* Good telephone etiquette.
* Strong coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality.

5\. Personal Attributes

* Well\-groomed and professional personality.
* Punctual and responsible.
* Patient\-friendly and empathetic.
* Team\-oriented.
* Positive attitude.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends/holidays if required.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Patient registration accuracy.
* Appointment scheduling accuracy.
* Patient/visitor satisfaction.
* Response time to enquiries and calls.
* Accuracy of front\-office documentation.
* Coordination with hospital departments.
* Attendance and punctuality.
* Compliance with hospital policies and procedures.

7\. Working Conditions

The position requires working at the hospital reception/front\-office area and interacting continuously with patients, attendants, visitors, doctors, and hospital staff. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced healthcare environment and rotational shifts.

**Salary:** As per experience and hospital norms.

**Location:** Vighnaharta Super Speciality Hospital, Keshavnagar, Mundhwa, Pune.

**Job Description**

**About the Role:**

**Department overview**
=======================


As a leading force in transaction reporting worldwide, the Cappitech team has been delivering Regulatory Technology solutions for over twenty years. Our cloud\-based, cross\-regulation Software as a Service (SaaS) platform empowers banks, brokers, hedge funds, asset managers, insurance companies, and corporates to meet global regulatory standards seamlessly. With a diverse workforce representing our global clientele, we embody S\&P Global values of inclusivity, collaboration, and integrity. Our management is committed to fostering a workplace that nurtures the growth and potential of our colleagues. As our support team expands, you will play a pivotal role in sustaining our momentum. Join a team of innovators dedicated to problem\-solving and delivering unparalleled customer experiences in a dynamic environment. Together, we serve our diverse global clientele with excellence.


**Position Summary**


We are seeking an individual capable of delivering outstanding customer experience across diverse clientele, while efficiently managing client workflows, to join the S\&P Cappitech Support and Operations team. The ideal candidate will possess adept communication skills for interacting with clients, addressing regulatory inquiries, and resolving daily reporting challenges. Experience with EMIR, MiFID, ASIC, MAS, CFTC, SEC, and SFTR regulatory operations will be a plus. This client\-facing role demands a high level of technical proficiency. * Addressing customer inquiries and requests promptly and efficiently, ensuring resolution within specified timelines.

* Possession of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in business administration, technology, or a related field.

* Freshers or demonstrated experience in financial markets or fintech.
* Understanding of the trade lifecycle across major financial asset classes including securities finance, exchange\-traded, and OTC derivatives.
* Ability to comprehend technical concepts.
* Competence in querying and extracting data from databases.

* Proficient in both verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal abilities.

**Base Location:** Thane City, Maharashtra

**About Us**

We are a technology\-driven company focused on innovative heat management and functional coating solutions for industrial and commercial applications. Our products are designed to address real\-world challenges related to heat, energy efficiency, surface performance, and protection.

We work closely with customers and project partners to understand application requirements and develop practical, value\-driven solutions. As we continue to grow, we are looking for motivated professionals who enjoy working in a dynamic, hands\-on environment and want to be part of taking innovative products from concept and customer engagement through to successful project execution.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a proactive and organized **Marketing \& Sales Assistant** to support the company’s marketing, sales, technical sales, and project coordination activities, with a focus on **heat management functional coatings**.

The role will involve customer interaction, lead follow\-ups, technical sales support, site visits, tender documentation, project tracking, and coordination with various functions of the company to effectively move projects from **initial enquiry to execution**.

**1\. Marketing \& Sales**

**3\. Project \& Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Follow up on pending actions and highlight delays or bottlenecks to the concerned team.
* Ensure effective coordination and communication to move projects from **enquiry → technical evaluation → commercial closure → order → execution**.

**4\. Tender Support**

* Assist in preparing and compiling **tender documentation and technical/commercial submissions**.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect required documents, certificates, product information, and supporting data.
* Assist with online/offline tender filings and ensure submissions are completed within timelines.
* Maintain records of tenders, deadlines, submissions, clarifications, and outcomes.

**5\. Administrative Support**

* Assist the Marketing Head with reports, trackers, documentation, meetings, and other marketing\-related activities.
* Support the Office Manager with general administrative tasks whenever required.
* Maintain organized records and documentation related to customers, projects, tenders, and sales activities.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be **energetic, proactive, organized, and comfortable in both customer\-facing and coordination roles**. The candidate should have an interest in technical products and the ability to learn and communicate technical concepts effectively.

**Key Skills**

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong follow\-up, coordination, and organizational abilities.
* Interest in **technical/industrial sales**.
* Ability to understand and communicate technical product information.
* Willingness to travel for customer and site visits.
* Good attention to detail, particularly for tenders and documentation.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively across multiple departments.

**Education \& Experience**

* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn may also be considered.

**Key Performance Areas**

* Effective follow\-up and conversion of marketing leads.
* Customer engagement and development of new opportunities.
* Timely completion of site visits, trials, quotations, and follow\-ups.
* Accurate and timely tender documentation and submissions.
* Effective tracking of project status and pending actions.
* Strong coordination across internal functions.
* Contribution toward moving projects from **lead/enquiry stage to execution**.

**What We Are Looking For**

A **hands\-on team player** who can comfortably switch between customer calls, site visits, technical discussions, documentation, tender support, and internal coordination—and most importantly, **takes ownership of follow\-ups and gets things moving**.

**How to Apply**

If you are enthusiastic about **technical sales, customer engagement, and project execution** and would like to be part of a growing technology\-driven company, we would love to hear from you.

**Send your CV to**  **admin@novota.in** **with the subject line “Application – Marketing \& Sales Assistant”.**

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** Freshers / 0–2 Years

**Industry:** Fire \& Safety / Fire Protection

About the Role

Varistor Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for **ITI Fitter freshers** to join our Service Engineering team for **fire extinguisher servicing, refilling, installation and maintenance**.

This is a hands\-on field service role suitable for candidates who enjoy working with tools, mechanical equipment and visiting customer sites. **Freshers are welcome**, and complete product and technical training will be provided.

The selected candidate will be trained in fire extinguisher servicing, refilling procedures, inspection, installation, troubleshooting and basic fire safety practices.

Key Responsibilities

* Carry out **fire extinguisher inspection, servicing and refilling** at customer locations and company premises.
* Assist in the installation and commissioning of fire extinguishers and other fire safety equipment.
* Dismantle, clean, inspect and reassemble extinguishers as per company procedures.
* Check extinguisher components for damage, leakage, corrosion and general condition.
* Perform basic mechanical troubleshooting and replacement of defective components.
* Use hand tools and workshop equipment safely and correctly.
* Assist senior engineers during installation, maintenance and service activities.
* Conduct periodic maintenance and preventive servicing of fire extinguishers.
* Ensure extinguishers are properly filled, pressurized, sealed, labelled and ready for use.
* Maintain service records, inspection reports and job completion documentation.
* Handle company tools, equipment, spares and materials responsibly.
* Travel to customer sites for service and maintenance assignments.
* Follow all company safety procedures and customer\-site safety requirements.
* Maintain professional behaviour and communication while dealing with customers.
* Report damaged equipment, recurring issues and material requirements to the reporting manager.
* Complete assigned service work within the given timeline.

Required Qualification

**Mandatory:**

* ITI – **Fitter** certification.
* Basic understanding of mechanical tools and equipment.
* Willingness to work in a field\-based technical role.

**Freshers are encouraged to apply.**

Candidates with experience in **fire extinguishers, fire\-fighting equipment, mechanical maintenance, fabrication or industrial servicing** will have an added advantage.

Skills We Are Looking For

* Good hands\-on mechanical skills.
* Comfortable using spanners, wrenches, screwdrivers and other hand tools.
* Basic understanding of mechanical components.
* Good observation and troubleshooting skills.
* Willingness to learn fire safety products and service procedures.
* Good discipline and attention to safety.
* Ability to follow technical instructions and standard operating procedures.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

Mandatory Requirements

* **Valid two\-wheeler driving licence is mandatory.**
* Willingness to travel to customer sites across Bengaluru and other assigned locations.
* Comfortable with hands\-on work and field service.
* Candidates should be physically comfortable handling fire extinguishers and related equipment.

Training Provided

Selected freshers will receive practical training in:

* Fire extinguisher types and applications
* Fire extinguisher installation
* Extinguisher inspection and servicing
* Fire extinguisher refilling procedures
* Pressure checking and basic testing
* Component replacement
* Basic troubleshooting
* Fire safety practices
* Customer\-site safety procedures
* Service documentation and reporting
* Customer handling and product demonstration

Compensation \& Benefits

* **₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month**, based on skills and performance.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Travel / mobile / maintenance allowances as applicable.
* Provident Fund.
* Health Insurance.
* On\-the\-job technical training.
* Career growth opportunities in the Fire \& Safety industry.

Career Growth

**ITI Fitter → Service Technician → Service Engineer → Senior Service Engineer → Service Supervisor**

This position is an excellent opportunity for an **ITI Fitter fresher looking to build a career in fire protection, technical service and field engineering.**

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on, hardworking, willing to travel, eager to learn and interested in technical field work**. Prior fire safety experience is not mandatory for freshers.

**Join Variex and build a career in Fire \& Safety Service Engineering.**

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**Who We Are?**

We are a global Business Consulting organization working with B2B technology clients across GTM Strategy, Market Intelligence, Lead Generation, Inside Sales, Digital Marketing, and Sales Consulting. We specialize in serving clients across ERP, IoT, IAM, Cybersecurity, PaaS, and other emerging technology domains. Our clients include Fortune 500 companies and leading global technology organizations looking to accelerate pipeline growth and expand into international markets.

Location: **Pune**

Shift: **US \& Europe**

**Position Overview** 

We are looking for a highly motivated Lead / Demand Generation Executive to join our growing Business Development team. The primary responsibility of this role is to generate Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Highly Qualified Leads (HQLs) through international outbound cold calling for global B2B technology campaigns. The ideal candidate should have prior experience working with international markets, possess excellent communication skills, and understand modern lead qualification methodologies such as BANT and Waterfall.

**Key Responsibilities** 

* Execute high\-volume international outbound cold calling campaigns targeting North America (NA), Europe (EU), EMEA, and APAC markets.
* Generate Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Highly Qualified Leads (HQLs) for B2B technology campaigns.
* Qualify prospects using BANT, Waterfall, or campaign\-specific qualification frameworks.
* Engage with Managers, Directors, VPs, C\-level executives, and technical decisionmakers to identify business opportunities.
* Conduct account and prospect research using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and sales intelligence platforms before initiating outreach.
* Understand prospect requirements, current environment, business challenges, technology landscape, and buying intent.
* Maintain consistent follow\-ups with prospects to nurture and qualify opportunities.
* Accurately update CRM with call outcomes, lead status, qualification details, and activity reports.
* Work closely with Research, Quality, and Business Development teams to improve lead quality and campaign performance.
* Consistently achieve daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs related to outbound calling, qualified leads, and campaign performance.

**Required Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or any related discipline.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in International B2B Lead Generation or Demand Generation.
* Hands\-on experience in international outbound cold calling targeting North America, Europe, EMEA, APAC, or other global markets.
* Experience working on MQL, HQL, BANT, Waterfall, or similar lead qualification methodologies.
* Appointment Generation (AG) campaign experience will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with B2B technology campaigns such as IoT, SaaS, ERP, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Telecom, or other enterprise technologies is preferred.
* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
* Strong objection handling, probing, and qualification skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.

**Preferred Tools \& Skills** 

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, or similar prospecting platforms
* HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, or equivalent CRM tools
* International outbound calling and dialer platforms
* BANT \& Waterfall qualification methodologies
* Prospect research and account mapping
* CRM management and reporting
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills

**Why Join LeadsINFRA?**

* Work with Fortune 500 companies and leading global technology brands.
* Gain exposure to international B2B technology markets and enterprise sales processes.
* Attractive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Comprehensive training, mentorship, and career development programs.
* Fast\-track career growth with opportunities to work on global technology projects.
* Dynamic, performance\-driven culture that recognizes and rewards excellence.
* Opportunity to build expertise across IoT, ERP, Cybersecurity, AI, Cloud, and other emerging technologies.
