title: Robotics Trainer
description:
Job Summary

A Robotics Trainer is responsible for teaching robotics, electronics, coding, AI, IoT, and STEM concepts to school students through hands\-on learning. The trainer will conduct practical sessions, guide students in projects and competitions, maintain laboratory equipment, and foster innovation and problem\-solving skills among students.

Key Roles \& ResponsibilitiesTraining \& Teaching

* Conduct Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, IoT, and STEM classes for students.
* Deliver engaging practical sessions using robotics kits, microcontrollers, and sensors.
* Explain technical concepts in a student\-friendly manner.
* Develop lesson plans and training materials aligned with school requirements.

Project Development

* Guide students in building robotics and STEM projects.
* Mentor students for science exhibitions, competitions, and innovation challenges.
* Support students in project design, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Encourage creativity, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

STEM Lab Management

* Maintain robotics kits, tools, components, and laboratory equipment.
* Ensure proper inventory management of STEM lab materials.
* Report damaged or missing equipment and coordinate replacements.
* Maintain safety standards within the laboratory.

Technical Support

* Assist students in coding using Arduino, Scratch, Python, and other relevant platforms.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues during training sessions.
* Support installation and configuration of robotics hardware and software.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain attendance and training records.
* Prepare progress reports for students and schools.
* Document student projects and achievements.
* Capture photos and videos of activities for reporting and promotional purposes.

Competition \& Event Coordination

* Train students for robotics competitions and hackathons.
* Organize STEM workshops, innovation camps, and demonstrations.
* Support school\-level and inter\-school robotics events.

Continuous Learning

* Stay updated with emerging technologies in Robotics, AI, IoT, and STEM education.
* Participate in internal training and skill development programs.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Physics (B.Sc.), Mathematics (B.Sc.), Electronics (B.Sc.), or any other relevant STEM discipline.
* Freshers with strong technical skills are encouraged to apply.
* Prior teaching or training experience is an added advantage.

Required Technical Skills

* Arduino Programming
* Electronics and Circuit Design
* Robotics Systems
* Embedded Systems
* Python Programming (Basic to Intermediate)
* IoT Concepts
* Sensor and Actuator Integration
* Basic AI and Machine Learning Concepts
* Troubleshooting and Debugging

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

title: Human Resources Trainee (Intern)
description:
**About Bizom** 




 Bizom is the retail intelligence platform of choice for more than 750\+ global brands helping them improve their channel, manpower and process efficiency.
 



 Every day, our systems run the heartbeat of modern distribution, including salesforce automation, distributor management, retail execution, trade marketing, and AI\-driven insights, reaching millions of retail outlets and field users across emerging markets.
 



 Excited to know more about us? Learn more about Bizom here and discover what makes our culture truly people\-first: Algorithmic Jugaad.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Ever watched a company go through massive growth and wondered,
 *"How do they keep their teams motivated, balanced, and highly productive through all that high\-speed change?"* 
 That does not happen by accident. It takes a strategic thinker who knows exactly how to connect people's core strengths with the actual needs and speed of the business.
 



  





 If you are genuinely fascinated by what makes people tick, have a natural drive to solve problems, and love helping teams succeed, you are in the right place. We are not looking for a traditional HR who simply checks boxes from behind a desk. We want a dynamic partner who is obsessed with employee success, fixes team bottlenecks like a professional, and focuses on building a workplace culture rooted in high trust. You will step right into the huddle with our business leaders to turn great talent strategies into real\-world impact.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 When you put on the cape, here is what your day\-to\-day mission looks like. You will be talking to our leaders and teams every day to:
 


* **Drive Strategic Retention Initiatives:** 
 You will run targeted programs to combat attrition, protect our high\-potential employees, and build an environment where our top talent actively chooses to stay and grow.
* **Map and Execute FLOW Mapping:** 
 You will routinely audit team skill levels against task complexity to make sure everyone stays in their optimal "Flow State"\-systematically preventing boredom on one end and burnout on the other.
* **Own Capability Management:** 
 You will lead talent bucketing calibrations to categorize performance across teams, establishing clear, practical "Next Steps" action plans for every group to step up their game.
* **Proactively Track Early Warning Indicators (EWI):** 
 You won't wait for people to reach burnout. You will actively monitor flight risks, stress signals, and team friction to catch and resolve structural attrition before it happens.
* **Conduct High\-Impact Employee Check\-ins:** 
 You will lead structured, recurring 1\-on\-1 check\-ins across different divisions to stay deeply connected to grassroots employee sentiment, moral health, and operational hurdles.
* **Oversee Performance Follow\-ups:** 
 You will design, monitor, and execute tight performance follow\-up structures\-like Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs)\-turning underperformance into success stories.
* **Champion Clear Career Progression:** 
 You will build transparent, structured career pathing frameworks that show our people a vivid, exciting future map of their growth within the company.
* **Manage Employee Relations:** 
 You will be the definitive point of contact for issue mediation, behavioral escalations, and keeping our workplace fair, open, and psychologically safe.
* **Drive Employee Engagement:** 
 You will design meaningful engagement activities and pulse surveys that keep team morale high and breathe life into our core company values.
* **Leverage HR Analytics:** 
 You will rely heavily on workforce data, dashboards, and metrics to track organizational health, spans, layers, and project impact, using these data\-driven insights to back up your recommendations during leadership reviews.



  





**Skills:** 




 You are the perfect fit for this role if you bring these superpowers to the table:
 


* **An Ownership Mindset:** 
 You are passionate about taking complete accountability, solving human capital or performance bottlenecks, and driving culture and productivity outcomes without needing to be micro\-managed.
* **Comfort with Data and Numbers:** 
 You have a strong understanding of metrics, organizational structures, spans, and layers, and you love using HR analytics to back up your strategy.
* **Proactive Problem Solving:** 
 You have a data\-driven mindset with the ability to analyze workforce trends and early warning indicators (EWIs) to design actionable retention solutions.
* **Exceptional Communication:** 
 Your presentation and stakeholder management skills are top\-notch. You speak with clarity of thought and articulation.
* **High\-Trust Relationship Building:** 
 You can navigate complex internal dynamics smoothly, build deep relationships, and earn high trust with both leadership and cross\-functional teams.
* **Consultative \& Behavioral Thinking:** 
 You possess a strong analytical mindset regarding human behavior and corporate dynamics, approach issues with an employee\-first lens, and seamlessly align tools like PIPs or FLOW mapping directly to business productivity.
* **Multi\-Tasking \& Agility:** 
 You have experience managing internal talent accounts or employee relations cases across multiple divisions simultaneously, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Resilience Under Pressure:** 
 You remain calm, objective, and deeply empathetic during business restructuring, structure adjustments, or severe escalations.
* **Flawless Follow\-Through:** 
 You have incredible execution planning skills and sharp attention to detail when tracking development milestones and closing action items.



  





**The League You will Grow With:** 




 This isn't just a job; it’s your launchpad. By joining our league, you will:
 


* **Work with the Best:** 
 Get the opportunity to collaborate with highly ambitious, sharp, and result\-oriented people from across the globe.
* **Partner with Business Heads:** 
 Work closely with business heads and functional leaders to understand how talent health directly transforms operational execution and market growth.
* **See Your Impact Fast:** 
 Own your strategic ideas, retention frameworks, and developmental programs, and watch your immediate impact on organizational productivity and team health.
* **Build Future Leaders:** 
 Work on real organizational design challenges that directly influence manager capability and skill\-to\-challenge balance (Flow state).
* **Accelerate Your Career:** 
 Move fast along your career pathing by working directly at the intersection of business operations and people strategy.
* **Thrive in a Trust\-First Culture:** 
 Be part of a culture where leaders are built from within through absolute ownership, hustle, and consistent corporate impact\-not just hierarchy or clock\-watching.



  





**Why Bizom?** 



* We are happy Souls, working together and having each other’s back! People, Product and Profit is our motto.
* Fly beyond your imagination as we believe in giving wings to your passion.
* No Kinder\-garden, We fall, We learn and we stick together like a chewing\-gum.
* We trust in our association and allow free rein to our employees. To act and explore themselves while delivering the best and sustainable results.
* We celebrate success hard and failures harder, It's always a collective success or collective failure. We enjoy our learnings more with a sip of our poison;)
* Have Buddies, Mentors But be your own boss. It goes hand in hand.
* Know your people, Talk, Chat, learn and Share \- have access anytime to reach anyone in the family.
* Stay Quiet \- Stay Foolish. We are courageous people who speak and do right things keeping in heart to serve best to our clients and our company.
* We believe in rolling our sleeves up, getting our hands dirty, dreaming and achieving together.



  





**What Will you get while working with Bizom?** 



* Work is Fun \- We believe work is fun\-and we go the extra mile to make sure you enjoy what you do every single day.
* Design Your Own Role \- You don’t just fit into a job\-we let you shape it. Take up what excites you, and we’ll back you with trust and responsibility.
* Freedom to Own Your Work \- Less rules, more trust. You get the freedom to figure things out your way\-with the right support when needed.
* Take Full Ownership \- It’s your ship. You steer it. You own it. You make things happen.
* Grow into a Leader \- This isn’t just a job\-it’s your launchpad to becoming a strong, independent leader.
* People Come First \- Always. We back our people through thick and thin. That’s our culture.
* Stay Fit \& Feel Good \- We care about your health\-with fitness activities, sports, and regular wellness sessions to keep you balanced.
* Happy Tummy, Happy You \- Enjoy fresh, tasty meals every day at our very own in\- house cafeteria. We take food seriously!

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

 The Manager / Senior Manager – Human Resources leads the day\-to\-day delivery of HR operations for a geographically dispersed workforce across India, ensuring that HR services are compliant, timely, accurate, and employee\-centric. The role is the operational engine of the HR function: it runs the employee lifecycle, administers statutory compliance, and maintains HR systems and records so that the Director – HR \& Administration is freed to focus on the organisation’s strategic HR transformation agenda. Reporting to and working under the direction of the Director – HR \& Administration, the incumbent translates HR strategy and policy into consistent, well\-executed practice on the ground. The role suits a hands\-on, service\-oriented, and detail\-driven HR professional who takes ownership of operational delivery, applies sound judgment on routine matters, and escalates sensitive or policy\-level issues appropriately.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Delivery**
* Run end\-to\-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle — recruitment coordination, offer and appointment issuance, onboarding, confirmations, transfers, contract renewals, and separations — ensuring accurate and timely execution.
* Prepare and issue all employment documentation (offer, appointment, confirmation, revision, and relieving letters) in line with organisational policy and templates.
* Maintain and continuously improve standard operating procedures for HR service delivery, ensuring consistency across the Country Office and State Offices.


**Statutory \& Policy Compliance — Execution**
* Administer full compliance with applicable Indian labour laws and statutory obligations (PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, POSH, and related filings), maintaining all statutory registers and records in audit\-ready condition.
* Apply HR policies and donor requirements consistently and accurately across the workforce; refer interpretation, exceptions, and policy revision to the Director.
* Support internal, statutory, and donor audits by preparing HR documentation, responding to queries, and closing action points within agreed timelines.


**HRIS, Records \& HR MIS**
* Operate and maintain the HRIS and personnel records as the single source of truth, safeguarding data accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality.
* Generate periodic HR dashboards and MIS — headcount, attrition, leave, hiring status, and compliance trackers — to support the Director’s decision\-making and reporting obligations.
* Ensure timely and accurate HR data inputs for organisational, donor, and HQ reporting requirements.


**Payroll Inputs, Benefits \& Attendance Administration**
* Administer leave and attendance and prepare accurate monthly payroll inputs in coordination with Finance.
* Administer employee benefits and insurance (medical, group, and statutory), including enrolments, claims coordination, and renewals.


**Employee Query Resolution \& First\-Line Support**
* Serve as the first point of contact for staff on HR matters, resolving routine queries promptly while maintaining a positive employee experience.
* Handle employee information and sensitive matters with fairness, objectivity, and strict confidentiality; escalate employee\-relations, grievance, and disciplinary matters to the Director for direction.


**State \& Field Office HR Coordination**
* Coordinate consistent HR service delivery to State and field offices, supporting HR focal points and ensuring uniform application of policy and process across locations.
* Track and resolve location\-specific HR operational issues, escalating those requiring policy or leadership attention.


**Implementation Support to HR Transformation**
* Provide execution and implementation support to the HR transformation, digitisation, and process\-improvement initiatives led by the Director — including rolling out new systems, SOPs, and policies, and embedding them into day\-to\-day operations.
* Identify and surface operational pain points and improvement opportunities from frontline delivery to inform the Director’s strategic priorities.


**Key Competencies**
**Functional Expertise**
* Strong, hands\-on command of HR operations, employee lifecycle management, and HR service delivery.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance, with demonstrated ability to administer them accurately.
* Proficiency in operating HRIS/HRMS platforms and producing HR MIS and dashboards from workforce data.
* Experience delivering HR services to a multi\-location, geographically dispersed workforce.


**Delivery \& Interpersonal Effectiveness**
* Service\-oriented, responsive, and dependable, with a strong sense of ownership over operational delivery.
* Sound judgment on routine matters and the discipline to escalate sensitive or policy\-level issues appropriately.
* Effective coordinator and communicator across functions, locations, and levels; collaborative team player.


**Personal Attributes**
* High integrity and discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Detail\-oriented, organised, and accurate, with the ability to manage multiple priorities to deadline.
* Adaptable and resilient in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment; comfortable adopting new systems and ways of working.


**Required Qualifications**

title: Employee Relations Manager, Employee Experience and Relations (EXR)
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Employee Relations and Experience (EXR) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations EXR team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives.
   

  

 In this role, you'll independently own and advance employee relations programs that foster a fair, respectful workplace aligned with our goal of being Earth's Best Employer. You'll partner with Field Operations and HR teams to proactively design people programs, analyze employee feedback data, identify and mitigate risks, and manage large\-scale network projects—while also handling critical, time\-sensitive employee relations issues.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and advance numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee ER vulnerability assessment programs. The individual also will work on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in position.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of employee relations, labor relations, human resources, operations or related field experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources Management or a related field
* 6\+ years of relevant professional experience

**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full\-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an
 **HR Business Partner \& Operations** 
 to be a strategic and hands\-on partner to our business leaders. You'll sit at the intersection of people strategy and execution : shaping how teams are structured, how performance and culture are managed, and making sure the operational backbone of HR (systems, policies, processes, compliance, data) runs without friction. **Business Partnering**

* Act as a trusted advisor and change agent through periods of organizational transformation and rapid growth.
* Address employee relations matters, lead investigations where needed, and resolve conflicts fairly and swiftly.


**People Operations \& HR Systems**
* Own and continuously improve core HR processes across the employee lifecycle — onboarding, performance cycles, transfers, and exits.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement HRMS tools for employee data, compensation, and performance management, ensuring the stack scales cleanly with headcount growth.

* Support compensation and benefits administration, including data accuracy, benchmarking inputs, and cycle execution.
* Maintain and improve HR systems, dashboards, and reporting to give leadership clean, timely people data.
* Support talent acquisition through workforce planning inputs and candidate evaluation where needed.


**Culture \& Engagement**

* Champion a high performance, high trust culture aligned with Sarvam's mission and pace.


**Requirements**
* Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of HR experience, with at least 4 years in an HRBP, People Operations, or similar generalist role.
* Hands\-on experience in implementing HRMS/HRIS platforms (e.g., Darwinbox, Keka, Rippling, Lattice or similar) is strongly preferred.
* Strong grounding in HR compliance, and process design.
* Comfortable owning both strategic conversations with leaders and the operational details that make HR systems and processes work reliably.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Thrives in a fast paced, high growth, ambiguity tolerant environment: startup or scale\-up experience is a plus.


**Why Sarvam?**
* Sarvam is a fast moving, high talent density team building full\-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population scale impact.
* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar.
* High impact, high agency role shaping HR strategy and systems from the ground up at a fast scaling AI company.
* Be part of a mission driven team building India's sovereign AI stack, with exposure to a wide range of HR challenges, from strategy to systems.


*If you’re passionate about shaping the people agenda in a mission first, cutting edge AI company, we’d love to hear from you!*

 .

**What we are looking for:** 



* 0–1 years of experience; fresh graduates from Tier 1 / leading institutions are encouraged to apply.

 **Excel / Google Sheets** 
 ; knowledge of data analysis is a plus.

**What Success looks like** 




 In this role, success is not just about completing assigned tasks. You will be expected to:
 


* Take ownership of operational problems.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and productivity.

* Work effectively with frontline teams and stakeholders.

 At Instafix, you will get an opportunity to work at the intersection of business, technology and operations.

* Solving real customer and operational problems.
* Working directly with senior leadership and cross\-functional teams.

description:
The Service Sales Business Analyst – Tender \& Order Operations plays a critical role in supporting the Service Sales organization by driving business analytics, managing tender documentation, and ensuring timely and accurate order processing. The role is responsible for maintaining business data integrity, supporting sales forecasting and reporting, coordinating tender submissions, and ensuring seamless execution of customer purchase orders from receipt through booking.

* Support Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), and annual operating planning.

* Maintain forecasting files and monitor forecast accuracy.
* Support pricing analysis and business improvement initiatives.
* Tender Management
* Monitor government, public sector, institutional, and private tender portals.
* Identify relevant service tender opportunities.
* Coordinate with Sales, Service Operations, Finance, Legal, and Product teams to gather required documents.
* Prepare complete technical and commercial bid submissions.
* Ensure timely submission of tenders before deadlines.
* Billable Quote Preparation and Order Processing
* Preparing the Billable activities quotation as per field service engineer requests and submission of the same to customers.
* Review customer Purchase Orders (POs) for completeness and compliance.
* Verify commercial terms, pricing, taxes, payment terms, and contract validity.
* Coordinate with Customer \& Service Sales rep for clarification on discrepancies.
* Process service contract, billable service, calibration, qualification, consumables, and spare part orders in ERP/CRM systems thru CO Team.
* Work with Service Operations to ensure smooth order execution.
* Monitor pending orders and resolve processing delays.
* Maintain order accuracy and documentation.

**In This Role, You Will:**
* Design, construct, install, test, and maintain scalable data pipelines and management systems.

* Ensure compliance with internal security and regulatory standards across all data processes.
* Integrate new data management technologies and software engineering tools into existing structures.
* Create custom software components and analytics applications to support business intelligence needs.

* Provide data\-access tools and visualization capabilities for non\-technical users.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in data engineering or data\-intensive development roles.
* Expertise in SQL, Python, and experience with CI/CD processes and Git.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, ETL processes, and data integration techniques.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, and containerized solutions (Docker).
* Hands\-on experience with orchestration tools like Apache Airflow and dbt.
* Solid understanding of data science concepts, ML frameworks, and big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark).
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver projects within deadlines.


**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**
* Experience with streaming data processes and real\-time analytics (Kafka, Flink).
* Focus on performance optimization, cost monitoring.
* Experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) and data visualization.
* Familiarity with marketing, eCommerce, and media data sources and their use cases.


**We Offer You:**

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state\-of\-the\-art campus is equipped with areas to co\-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic \& inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.


**The Hiring Process:**
* Your Application: Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* Initial Screening: Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* Hiring Manager Interview: Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* Stakeholder Interview: Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* Leadership \& HRBP Interaction: Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team \& HRBP.
* Feedback: After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* Job Offer: Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* First Working Day: Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!


**About Nespresso:**
 The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.
   

  

 Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.
   

  

 We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net\-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
   

  

 In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.
   

  

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*
 People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together
   

  

 Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.
   

  

**Join Nestlé \#beaforceforgood**

title: ML Engineer (Data), Foundational Models
description:
**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full\-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will own the data infrastructure that feeds our next family of foundational models. This means building petabyte\-scale curation and filtering pipelines, designing the systems that decide what goes into a training run and in what proportion, and treating data quality with the same rigor a research team would treat an architectural choice.
   

  

 This is not a glue\-code role. The data work at a serious pretraining lab is engineering\- and research\-heavy: deduplication at scale, quality models, contamination detection, mixture design, curriculum and annealing, attribution and debugging. You should care deeply about all of it.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design and build large\-scale data pipelines for pre\-training and post\-training — ingestion, parsing, normalization, filtering, deduplication, tokenization, and packing — at petabyte scale.
* Develop and continually improve quality filtering systems, including model\-based quality classifiers and contamination detection.
* Own data mixture design, curriculum, and annealing strategies in partnership with the research team. The question "what data did this model see, in what proportion, in what order" should always have a precise answer because of work you did.
* Build the tooling that lets researchers and engineers analyze, slice, attribute, and debug the data.
* Scale the pipeline to handle multilingual corpora, code, math, multi\-source web data, and licensed datasets, while keeping provenance and licensing tracked end\-to\-end.
* Partner with the training infrastructure team so that data is never the bottleneck of a production training run


**What We’re Looking For**
* BS or MS in Computer Science or a closely related technical field (or equivalent demonstrated experience).
* 3\+ years of experience building large\-scale data systems — petabyte\-scale processing, distributed data pipelines, or comparable. Exceptional early\-career candidates with a strong systems background will be considered.
* Hands\-on experience with data curation and filtering for LLM training. You should be able to walk through a pre\-training corpus you helped build, end to end, and defend the choices that went into it.
* Deep familiarity with distributed data processing frameworks — Spark, Ray, Beam, Dask, or equivalent — and the storage systems that sit underneath them.
* Strong Python; comfort with the low\-level pieces of the data path (tokenization, sharding, packing, IO patterns) and the performance tradeoffs they imply.
* Meaningful open\-source contributions in the data tooling ecosystem — datasets, dedup libraries, filtering frameworks, or substantive work on widely\-used open data releases.


**Bonus Points**
* Direct experience building or working with large open pretraining corpora.
* Work on multilingual data — collection, normalization, quality scoring, and mixing across many languages.
* Hands\-on experience with model\-based data quality classifiers, contamination detection, or data attribution research.
* Familiarity with tokenization research and the practical implications of tokenizer choices on training.
* First\-author papers or technical reports on data curation, quality, or pretraining mixtures.


**Why this role?**
 The frontier is moving towards data being the dominant lever in model quality, and the labs that get this right will define the next generation of models. You will be the person at Sarvam most responsible for that lever.
   

  

**Why Sarvam?**
 Sarvam is a fast\-moving, high talent\-density team building full\-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population\-scale impact.
   

  

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI\-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates


 If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Data Scientist I
description:
Kroll is hiring a Data Scientist to join its Enterprise Data Group. This role is ideal for an early\- to mid\-career practitioner who is eager to develop deep expertise across the ML lifecycle while contributing to high\-impact work in a sophisticated, collaborative data science team.
   

  

 Our program spans fintech product development, digital transformation, process automation with machine learning, business intelligence, data governance, and generative AI. You will be embedded in a team of experienced data scientists and engineers who will invest in your growth — and work alongside professionals from the world's largest financial institutions, law enforcement agencies, and government bodies.
   

  

 At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients' most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build, train, and evaluate machine learning models across traditional ML, NLP, and LLM/GenAI use cases, under the guidance of senior team members
* Contribute to data pipelines and feature engineering workflows in Databricks using PySpark and Delta Lake
* Support model deployment and monitoring on Azure — including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Functions — and help maintain production model health
* Contribute to LLM and generative AI workflows — including prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and agentic applications built on frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex — under the guidance of senior team members
* Conduct exploratory data analysis and communicate findings clearly through code, documentation, and team presentations
* Write clean, well\-tested, and reproducible Python code; contribute to shared codebases and track experiments via MLflow
* Partner with senior data scientists and cross\-functional stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into analytical approaches
* Participate actively in code reviews, team rituals, and knowledge\-sharing sessions
* Develop your skills proactively — engage with new tools, research, and techniques relevant to the team's work


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or a related quantitative field
* 1–3 years of practical data science or ML experience (internships, co\-ops, research, and strong project work all count)
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with core ML libraries (scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy)
* Solid understanding of foundational ML concepts: supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, cross\-validation, and feature engineering
* Exposure to at least one deep learning or NLP framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers) and familiarity with LLM concepts such as prompt engineering, embeddings, or retrieval\-augmented generation
* Comfort working with structured and unstructured data, including text and document\-based sources
* Basic understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data preparation and experimentation through evaluation and handoff
* Clear, organised communication skills — able to document work and explain methods to peers and stakeholders
* Curiosity, rigour, and a strong drive to learn in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, or cloud ML platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI)
* Hands\-on experience with LLM/GenAI and agentic workflows — prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or building with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel
* Familiarity with MLflow or other experiment tracking and model versioning tools
* Experience in financial services, risk, compliance, or a regulated industry
* Knowledge of responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, and data privacy

title: ML Engineer (Training Infra), Foundational Models
description:
**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full\-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will own the infrastructure that our next family of foundational models is trained on. This is a deep systems role: distributed training at scale, parallelism strategies, GPU kernel work, throughput and stability optimization, and the unglamorous reliability engineering that determines whether a frontier training run actually finishes.
   

  

 The bar is high. A bad MFU number, a slow data loader, a switch flap — these are problems whose cost is measured in weeks and millions of dollars. You will be expected to find them before they happen, and to fix them fast when they do.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build, maintain, and continually push the limits of our distributed training stack across large GPU clusters.
* Design and implement parallelism strategies — data, tensor, pipeline, sequence, expert — and reason about which combinations make sense for which architectures and which scales.
* Profile and optimize end\-to\-end training throughput: kernel performance, communication overlap, memory layout, checkpointing, data loading.
* Write and tune custom GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton) where off\-the\-shelf is leaving performance on the table.
* Own the reliability of long\-running training jobs — fault tolerance, checkpoint integrity, deterministic restarts, automated detection of slow nodes and silent corruption.
* Partner closely with researchers to make sure architectural ideas can actually be trained efficiently, and with the data team to keep the pipeline from being the bottleneck.


**What We’re Looking For**
* BS or MS in Computer Science or a closely related technical field (or equivalent demonstrated experience).
* 3\+ years of experience building ML training infrastructure or large\-scale distributed systems. Exceptional early\-career candidates with a strong systems background will be considered.
* Hands\-on experience training large models with distributed training frameworks — Megatron\-LM, DeepSpeed, FSDP, NeMo, or equivalent. You should have been on\-call for a real pretraining run.
* Deep working knowledge of GPU architecture, the CUDA programming model, and standard tools for profiling GPU workloads (Nsight, PyTorch profiler, etc.).
* Strong PyTorch internals knowledge. You're comfortable reading and modifying low\-level training code, not just using high\-level APIs.
* Meaningful open\-source contributions in the training infrastructure ecosystem — Megatron, DeepSpeed, PyTorch, vLLM, Triton, NCCL, or similar.


**Bonus Points**
* Custom CUDA or Triton kernel development with measurable wins on real workloads.
* Direct experience training models at 10B\+ parameters or on 1000\+ GPU clusters.
* Familiarity with cluster orchestration and job scheduling (Slurm, Kubernetes) at scale.
* Experience with mixed precision (BF16, FP8\), quantization\-aware training, or other numerical work that has shown up in production training runs.
* First\-author papers or technical reports on training systems, scaling, or model efficiency.


**Why this role?**
 Frontier model training is one of the hardest systems problems in the world right now, and most of the people doing it well sit at a small handful of labs. You will be doing the same work, with the same autonomy, and your impact will be visible in every model Sarvam ships.
   

  

**Why Sarvam?**
 Sarvam is a fast\-moving, high talent\-density team building full\-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population\-scale impact.
   

  

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI\-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates


 If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Analyst - Global Payroll Systems
description:
* Great opportunity to contribute to Rio Tinto's Global Payroll Systems and payroll transformation initiatives
* Support SAP Payroll testing, system enhancements, process governance and continuous improvement activities
* Collaborate with global payroll stakeholders, technical teams and business users across multiple regions
* The role is based in Gurgaon


****About The Role****
 We are looking for an adaptable and collaborative Analyst \- Global Payroll Systems \- to support the ongoing enhancement, testing and operational effectiveness of Rio Tinto's global payroll systems landscape. The selected individual will work closely with technical teams, payroll stakeholders and business users to validate system changes, resolve system\-related issues, maintain process documentation and support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance payroll service delivery and system performance.
   

  

****What The Role Entails****
 The role is a great opportunity for a professional with experience in payroll systems, SAP Payroll, process testing, validation and stakeholder engagement. Success in this role will require strong analytical capability, attention to detail, problem\-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams. The successful candidate will help ensure payroll system changes are delivered successfully, business requirements are met, and payroll processes remain compliant, stable and efficient.
   

  

**Reporting line** 
 Senior Adviser Global Payroll Systems
   

  

**Scope** 
 Your scope will include (but is not limited to) the following
   

  

* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for payroll system changes to ensure business requirements are met and expected outcomes are achieved.
* Identify, document and track defects, issues and system enhancements discovered during testing activities.
* Develop, maintain and update user documentation, including Job Aids, DTPs and process guides.
* Support system enhancements and customization initiatives by collaborating with SAP technical teams and other stakeholders as needed.
* Execute testing and monitoring activities to assess the health of ESPS processes, ensuring compliance with company policies, internal controls and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Provide technical guidance, support and knowledge sharing to ESPS team members whenever required.
* Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve payroll\-related system and process issues in a timely manner.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance payroll processes, system efficiency and overall service delivery.


****About Yourself****
 We are looking for candidates with
   

  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Human Resources, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional certifications, preferably related to SAP.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Payroll and Time Management testing and/or configuration processes.
* Strong intellectual curiosity with a passion for learning and adopting new technologies.
* Proven experience in payroll systems testing, validation, reconciliation and reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment while consistently maintaining high\-quality standards.
* Experience with Canadian and/or US payroll processes would be a distinct advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and end users.
* A collaborative team player who thrives in cross\-functional environments.
* Flexibility and willingness to work across different shifts as required.

title: L2/L3 Protocol Test Engineer
description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Family Definition:**
 Designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs software programs for software enhancements and new products. Develops software including operating systems, compilers, routers, networks, utilities, databases and Internet\-related tools. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Contributions include applying intermediate level of subject matter expertise to solve common technical problems. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and recommendations for appropriate action. Works independently within an established framework and with moderate supervision.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop, execute and automate comprehensive feature test plans for Layer 2/Layer 3 networking protocols (e.g. STP, RSTP, MSTP, VRRP, MC\-LAG, LACP, L2PT, LLDP, VPLS, EVPN, OSPF, ISIS, BGP, and MACSEC), based on detailed feature requirements.
* Design and improve test automation frameworks by creating new automation libraries and implementing complex automation algorithms to enhance test efficiency and coverage.
* Utilise strong analytical skills to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues discovered during testing, ensuring timely identification of root causes.
* Implement and execute test cases, including developing automated test scripts (using Python PyTest and Robot Framework) to streamline repetitive testing tasks.
* Use networking test equipment (e.g. Spirent, Ixia) to generate traffic and validate performance, including automating these tools for comprehensive test coverage.
* Report on testing progress and outcomes through clear documentation and regular status updates.
* Handle critical customer queries and escalations, working quickly to reproduce issues and assist in resolving them to maintain customer satisfaction.


**What You Need To Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* Typically 1\-3 years experience.
* In\-depth knowledge of switches, routers, and IP networking fundamentals.
* Specialisation in one or more of the following areas:
+ Layer 2: Mastery of service provider, data centre, and switching technologies – including STP/RSTP/MSTP, VRRP, MCLAG, LACP, L2PT, LLDP, VPLS, and MACSEC.
+ Layer 3: Expertise in routing protocols and MPLS – including OSPF, ISIS, BGP, and MPLS.
+ Quality of Service \& Security: In\-depth understanding of Class of Service (CoS) mechanisms and firewall/ACL configurations.
+ Hardware \& Multicast: Familiarity with Broadcom Packet Forwarding Engine (PFE) architecture and multicast networking (including multicast snooping).
+ Virtual Networking: Hands\-on experience with EVPN technologies (EVPN\-MPLS and EVPN\-VXLAN) and VPLS services.
+ Test tools: Experience with networking test equipment (Spirent, Ixia) and the ability to automate testing using these tools.

With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Performance / Load Testing Domain Lead provides leadership for the performance testing capability within the SQA organization, supporting enterprise applications through performance, load, stress, and scalability testing. This role defines and maintains performance testing practices, standards, and execution approaches to ensure systems meet expected levels of responsiveness, stability, and reliability.
   

  

 The Domain Lead serves as a hands?on technical leader, guiding a small team of performance testing specialists while remaining directly involved in complex or high?risk initiatives. The role mentors team members, reviews work products, and establishes best practices for workload design, test execution, results analysis, and performance risk reporting.
   

  

 Working closely with application development teams, architecture, infrastructure/cloud partners, and internal performance engineering resources, the Domain Lead helps identify and address performance risks early in the delivery lifecycle. The role supports a diverse application portfolio, including modern cloud?native and AI?driven solutions, applying data?driven and intelligent techniques to improve testing efficiency, insight, and consistency.

**Description**
 Selling on Amazon is one of the fastest growing businesses at Amazon.com, with more than 50% of all items currently sold originating from third\-party sellers. The SPEAQ (Selling Partner Experience, Automation \& Qualification) team is looking for a Systems Development Engineer who will design, build, and operate infrastructure and automation systems that power the solution provider lifecycle, from registration through qualification and listing. You will own the full engineering lifecycle, from design through deployment and operations, building production\-grade workflow orchestration, automation pipelines, and self\-service platforms at scale across distributed AWS services.
   

  

 Our team enables solution providers to list their first solution quickly while ensuring trust and security are embedded into every step. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will: design state machine workflow orchestration for onboarding and qualification, engineer CDK\-based infrastructure for multi\-region deployments, develop automated qualification and listing vetting pipelines using Step Functions, Lambda, DynamoDB, and other AWS\-native services, and create proactive monitoring with fail\-fast alerting across mission\-critical jobs. You will write code held to Amazon Code Bar standards and work across Java and Python to deliver solutions where no prior playbook exists.
   

  

 You will join a world\-class team of Software Development Engineers, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers and Systems Development Engineers in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You design and build automation systems that power qualification, onboarding orchestration, and communication workflows across the solution provider ecosystem. You own the full engineering lifecycle, from low\-level design through deployment and operations, writing production\-grade code held to Amazon Code Bar standards. You build and maintain workflow automation using state machine orchestration (Step Functions), data pipelines (Lambda, DynamoDB), and CDK\-based infrastructure.
   

  

 You develop proactive monitoring and fail\-fast alerting to ensure pipeline reliability. You design unified qualification forms with built\-in validations backed by modernized backend infrastructure. You build self\-service workflow capabilities that enable trust teams to create automation without engineering dependency. You participate in on\-call rotations, conduct root cause analysis, and engineer solutions that eliminate systemic issues rather than just addressing symptoms.
   

  

 You collaborate closely with Software Development Engineers, contributing to design and code reviews with substantive technical feedback. You create design documents, runbooks, and trade\-off analyses. You reduce operational toil by building force\-multiplier tooling. You automate manual processes and improve reliability, scalability, and observability across team\-owned services.
   

  

 You work with other Amazon leaders to share ideas and improve support across the company. You contribute to the strategic direction of the team. You play a significant role in hiring, mentoring, and training. You demonstrate excellent judgment when making decisions.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start each day reviewing workflow pipeline health and communication delivery alerts, ensuring data quality before downstream processes consume outputs. You join daily sync\-ups with SDEs to coordinate sprint work and unblock dependencies.
   

  

 Most of your time is spent building: writing production\-grade Java or Python to automate qualification workflows via Step Functions, standing up CDK infrastructure for Lambda and DynamoDB, and engineering onboarding pipelines that dynamically adapt to solution provider intent. You own what you build, from low\-level design through deployment and operations.
   

  

 You collaborate with SDEs who own qualification business logic, partner teams and SPEAQ leadership who rely on your systems. Your end customers are solution providers, the systems you build reduce onboarding time and let them focus on building great solutions.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About Juspay** 




 Juspay is a leading multinational payments technology company, powering superior conversion rates, seamless customer experiences, cost optimization, and fraud reduction at scale for 500\+ top global enterprises and banks. Founded in 2012, the company processes over 300 million daily transactions, exceeding an annualized total payment volume (TPV) of $1 trillion with 99\.999% reliability. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, Juspay’s global network of 1200\+ payment experts operates across San Francisco, Dublin, São Paulo, and Singapore.
 



  





 Juspay offers a modular and interoperable product suite for merchants that includes open source payment orchestration, seamless authentication, payment tokenization, fraud \& risk management, global payouts, end\-to\-end reconciliation, unified payment analytics, and more. For banks, Juspay’s offerings include end\-to\-end white label payment gateway solutions \& real\-time payments infrastructure.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We need a design that guarantees High\-Availability of five\-nines! A distributed, fault\-tolerant system with state of art engineering techniques, spanning across multiple DCs in Active\-Active mode is an absolute necessity.
 



  





**The Challenge** 




 Building Distributed systems at this scale is still an Art. While there are standard open\-source building blocks available, the right architecture or the way to combine the components needs creativity and deep first\-principles understanding. It also takes wisdom to make the right trade offs combining product/domain expertise with engineering excellence.
 



  





**What you’ll be working on** 




 At the core, we are an engineering\-focused organization with heavy investments in pure functional programming techniques and distributed system architectures. We use Haskell for backend development, we have invested in one of the fastest real\-time data streaming technologies, we created our own polyglot database management system called DBMesh.
 



  





 We are establishing a team to upgrade our system architecture to scale to 10X our current volume and support the high\-reliability needs with a multi\-region DC Active\-Active architecture.
 



  





 Some of the current projects in our distributed systems team:
 


* Designing our architecture to work active\-active across DCs with intelligent SDK and gateway proxies to route traffic between them.
* Moving to an LSM engine based distributed DB that spans across datacenter regions
* Service mesh architecture that provides failover across Kubernetes clusters
* Event sourcing and Event\-mesh architecture to move all operations outside the critical path to a reliable async mechanism.
* A multi\-DC \+ client\-side distributed data caching system and ensuring strong eventual consistency.
* Automatic anomaly detection system with streaming data streams across varied systems

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Why This Role Exists**
 Our team ships two production\-bound applications — a Lease Accounting Tool (Flask \+ MongoDB, ASC 842/GASB 87/96\) and a Book Close Validation Agent (FastAPI \+ React \+ MongoDB) — that are functionally complete but missing dedicated DevOps ownership. Both currently rely on developers manually running test suites and deployments. We need someone to own CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployment, and production hardening so releases stop depending on manual steps.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Stand up CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent) that auto\-run the existing test suites (currently 278 automated tests across Unit/Integration/Exception/Edge categories) on every PR — this is our single most overdue gap on the Lease Accounting Tool.
* Harden and manage Docker Compose\-based deployments across dev, QA, and production environments, including zero\-downtime rebuilds (docker compose up \-d \-\-build) and environment\-specific secrets management.
* Implement shared, production\-grade rate\-limit storage (Redis\-backed) to replace in\-memory rate limiting once multiple workers/instances go live.
* Own secret rotation, TLS termination, and JWT/session secret strength enforcement across environments — currently flagged as follow\-up hardening items in our Production Readiness Report.
* Set up centralized monitoring/alerting (uptime, error rates, MongoDB health) across both applications, building on existing /healthz endpoints.
* Maintain the dev to QA to main/prod branch promotion workflow, matching our documented Git branching strategy (feature branches into dev into QA into main).
* Own database backup/restore procedures and rollback runbooks for MongoDB\-backed services.
* Partner with developers to keep the CI drift\-gate in sync (e.g. SOP\-rule script mirroring between backend and frontend) so what's displayed always matches what actually runs.


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Docker \& Docker Compose in production (multi\-service, multi\-environment)
* CI/CD pipeline design (GitHub Actions strongly preferred — our repos are GitHub\-hosted)
* Python web app deployment experience (Flask or FastAPI, gunicorn/uvicorn, nginx reverse proxy)
* MongoDB operations: backups, indexes, GridFS, connection string management across environments
* Secrets management and environment hardening (JWT/session secrets, env handling, secret rotation)
* Comfort reading Python test output (pytest) and wiring it into automated pipelines Nice to Have
* Experience with Redis (for shared rate\-limiting/session storage across workers)
* Prior exposure to accounting/fintech compliance software (ASC 842, GASB, SOX) is a plus, not required
* React/Vite build pipeline experience (our second app is a Vite \+ FastAPI stack)

 Join a technical team focused on supporting and scaling modern cloud\-based data environments.
   

  

 In this role, you will help application teams onboard to Databricks and build reliable Data Landing Zones (DLZ).
   

  

 You will work with Azure resources, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and deployment pipelines to deliver efficient solutions.
   

  

 As a first\-line technical point of contact, you will troubleshoot requests and help resolve issues through structured support processes.
   

  

 You will also identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and continuously improve operational workflows.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on cloud engineering with application support in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 It is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in Databricks, Azure, IaC, and cloud automation while making a direct impact on data platform operations.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Provide first\-level technical support to application teams through the ServiceNow ticketing system, investigating and resolving common Databricks and cloud\-related requests.
* Gather, clarify, and analyze technical requirements for onboarding new Data Landing Zones (DLZs).
* Execute pipelines, scripts, and automated processes to provision, configure, or modify Azure and Databricks resources.
* Support the deployment of commonly requested Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
* Identify repetitive manual activities and develop automation to improve efficiency, consistency, and support response times.
* Collaborate with application, cloud, data, and other cross\-functional teams to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth onboarding.
* Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation covering support procedures, workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting processes.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud support operations and the overall Databricks environment.


**Requirements**
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience working with Databricks in a technical or operational environment.
* 1–3 years of experience with Azure Data Factory.
* Previous experience in application support, technical operations, cloud support, or a similar role.
* Familiarity with major cloud platforms, particularly Azure, with exposure to AWS or GCP considered an advantage.
* Experience using source\-control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.
* Understanding of Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, role\-based access control (RBAC), authentication mechanisms, and Delta Sharing is highly desirable.
* Experience working within the Azure ecosystem and understanding of cloud resource management.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CDK.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions is a plus.
* Scripting or development experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, combined with attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Ability to communicate clearly with application teams and collaborate effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work hands\-on with Databricks, Azure, cloud infrastructure, and modern data technologies.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and cloud platform operations.
* Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with application and cross\-functional technical teams.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in a growing data and cloud technology ecosystem.
* Role combining technical support, cloud engineering, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Potential for professional growth through exposure to a broad range of cloud and data platform challenges.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Why We Stand Out**
 Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!
   

  

 Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited's (the "Company") offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.
   

  

 The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back\-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is "people first". In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, "We prioritize our people, their development, and their well\-being. Our values are translated into action every day."
   

  

 Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri\-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
   

  

 The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023\. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.
   

  

**Think you have what it takes?**
 Mid\-level DevOps engineering role owning CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and FinOps practices across Azure and AWS. KR is actively migrating from AWS to Azure — this person plays a hands\-on role in that transition while keeping existing workloads healthy. Equally comfortable writing YAML pipelines, resolving a cost anomaly, and scripting in Python or Bash to automate an operational task. Security is embedded into every delivery step
   

  

**Requirements**
**How You'll Contribute:**
**CI/CD Pipeline Engineering**
* Build and maintain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for WES suite, AI apps, and M365 workloads
* Build GitHub Actions pipelines for AWS workloads during migration transition
* Implement DevSecOps in every pipeline — SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, container image scanning, secrets detection
* Enforce branching strategies, PR policies, and code review gates in Azure Repos and GitHub


**Azure Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineering**
* Provision and manage Azure infrastructure using Bicep and/or Terraform — AKS, Container Apps, App Services, Functions, API Management, VNets, NSGs
* Deploy and orchestrate containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS)
* Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting
* Support the AWS\-to\-Azure migration — assess workloads, map to Azure equivalents, execute runbooks


**AWS Infrastructure Management**
* Manage existing AWS infrastructure — EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3, ECS, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC
* Maintain AWS IaC using Terraform until decommission
* Coordinate workload cutover activities — DNS transitions, data sync validation, traffic shifting


**FinOps — Cloud Cost Management**
* Own FinOps practice across Azure and AWS — tagging, cost allocation, budget alerts, monthly reporting
* Conduct rightsizing reviews — over\-provisioned VMs, idle resources, orphaned disks
* Manage Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and Spot instance strategies
* Produce monthly FinOps reports with spend analysis and savings recommendations


**Security, Governance \& Reliability**
* Implement Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Azure Security Center, and AWS Security Hub controls
* Administer Linux/Unix systems — configuration, patching, hardening, and performance tuning
* Apply automation and scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) to eliminate manual toil


**What Skills You'll Bring:**
* 3\-5 years hands\-on DevOps / cloud engineering experience
* Azure IaC — Bicep/Terraform, AKS/Container Apps, Azure networking, RBAC, Azure Monitor, Key Vault
* AWS infrastructure — EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3, ECS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Terraform
* CI/CD with DevSecOps — SAST, DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets detection
* Containerization — Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Helm
* FinOps — cost allocation, rightsizing, reserved instances across Azure and AWS
* Automation \& scripting — Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell
* OS administration — strong Linux/Unix working knowledge
* AZ\-400, AZ\-104, AWS SA, or FinOps certifications preferred
* Excellent written and spoken English for stakeholder communication, technical documentation, and vendor interactions


**Benefits**
* Work\-Life Balance
* People First Company
* Hybrid work policy
* Working directly with peers in the US


***We embrace authenticity.***
*Kaufman Rossin is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a culture that reflects the diversity of our firm and clients. We encourage understanding, acceptance, and celebration among all people. That includes lifestyle, education, experience, race, ethnicity, age, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, and gender identity.* 
***Differences make unique varieties.***

title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
description:
**About Signant Health**
 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
   

  

 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a member of Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy and manage infrastructure, application components and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable and sustainable. You will also work with Apps Integration and the DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall Support Process.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Automation for tasks like deployment of servers and application software across environment, alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work\-arounds and resolution of reported issues
* Quickly \& effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve troubleshooting process in the long run
* Ensure the stability and availability of Application operation components running on Public Clouds.
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotation to support production environments and shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right\-size servers and services
* Migrate on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* BS degree in Computer Science or related discipline
* At least 3 years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices. Hands on experience with DevOps Tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, TFS
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, PowerShell
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
* Hands\-on experience in Linux/Windows server operating systems, and Web Server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere and Apache Web Server
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres or MySQL
* Proven ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, providing back\-up support to team members \& establishing/maintaining effective work relationships with co\-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.


**Desired Qualifications**
* 5\+ years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices
* Experience migrating on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation and shift work to support production environments
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need base


**Why Signant Health?**
 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
   

  

 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
   

  

 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
   

  

 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.
